The platform offers practice discovery by specialty and location, deposit-based online appointment booking, a conversational AI booking assistant (Heva AI), an online store for purchasing procedures and services, and secure payments via Stripe. Provider-facing tools cover practice management, patient acquisition, communications, and appointment coordination, delivered through the web and native iOS and Android provider apps. heva is a Techstars-backed company building "care without borders."

providers.name: Imperfect
providers.description: Imperfect (Imperfect Wellness, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) consumer startup building an adaptive AI training coach for endurance athletes across cycling, trail running, swimming, and other sports. The mobile app connects to a user's wearables and health apps to generate real-time training, recovery, and nutrition recommendations that adapt to how the athlete's body is actually responding day to day, rather than following a static plan written weeks in advance. Founded by Matin Tamizi (previously built and sold two fintech companies and authored a widely used open-source Garmin library used by Stanford Health). Imperfect ships as a consumer mobile application (Google Play) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Inkblot Therapy
providers.description: Inkblot Therapy is a Canadian digital mental health platform, part of GreenShield, that delivers secure virtual therapy and counselling online. It matches individuals to licensed counsellors, social workers, psychotherapists, and psychologists using a clinically designed questionnaire, and delivers confidential video sessions. Inkblot serves individuals directly, employers and organizations through Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and mental health benefits, and practitioners who provide care on the platform. The company operates consumer and business web applications (app.inkblottherapy.com, business.inkblottherapy.com) but does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI description. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; enrichment reflects the public web and DNS/security surface only.

providers.name: Instride Health
providers.description: InStride Health is a virtual mental health provider delivering specialized, insurance-based treatment for children, teens, and young adults ages 7 to 24 who struggle with anxiety, OCD, panic, phobias, school avoidance, and related disorders. Its structured four-to-eight month program pairs each patient with a coordinated care team of a therapist, a psychiatric prescriber, and an exposure coach, combining evidence-based cognitive behavioral therapy and exposure-and-response prevention delivered over telehealth. The company is backed by General Catalyst and tracked in the API Evangelist network; it operates as a clinical care provider and publishes no public API, developer program, or SDK.

providers.name: Koda Health
providers.description: Koda Health is a Houston-based digital health company whose AI-enhanced patient decision support platform digitizes serious illness planning for health systems, health plans, and value-based care organizations. Its two solutions — Advance Care Planning (ACP) and Kidney Action Planning (KAP) for chronic kidney disease — walk patients through video-guided, interactive goals-of-care conversations and produce legally compliant advance directives, medical power of attorney, and POLST/DNR documents with digital signing and notarization across all 50 states. Completed plans are pushed into the provider's EMR through an integration Koda states meets HL7 FHIR standards, and can be shared with care teams, payors, and family. KodaCares adds human Patient Advocates for complex cases. Koda publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; its API host (api.kodahealthcare.com) is a closed backend serving the app, and EMR interoperability is delivered through partner and health-system integrations rather than a self-serve public API.

providers.name: Meru Health
providers.description: Meru Health is a digital mental health company delivering a therapist-guided 12-week program for anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout. The platform blends licensed-therapist video sessions, an on-demand app of mindfulness and behavioral practices, an HRV biofeedback wearable, and anonymous peer support. Sold B2B2C to health plans and employers as a covered benefit, it is measurement-based and outcomes-focused. No public developer API, portal, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Motivo
providers.description: Motivo is the leading managed clinical supervision platform for behavioral health organizations. It connects pre-licensed and post-graduate mental health professionals with 1,500+ vetted clinical supervisors across all 50 states, enabling organizations to expand their workforce, reduce burnout, and meet licensure requirements. The fully-managed platform handles supervisor vetting, compliance and documentation, scheduling, HIPAA-compliant video sessions, and payment processing, and includes group supervision, peer consultation, webinars, and workforce-development resources. Motivo serves behavioral health centers, treatment facilities, health plans, and digital health companies. As of this profile Motivo publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its platform is delivered as a managed SaaS product and it consumes third-party APIs (e.g. Google Calendar) internally.

providers.name: Nectar
providers.description: Nectar (Nectar Life Sciences) is a hybrid, vertically-integrated allergy care platform combining at-home testing with in-person clinical care. Patients can self-test for dozens of indoor and outdoor environmental allergens using mail-in home kits, then receive personalized treatment including sublingual immunotherapy (allergy drops), prescription nasal sprays, rescue inhalers, and allergy shots. Its flagship Nectar Allergy Center in New York City treats adults and children for environmental allergies, asthma, food allergies, and eczema, alongside virtual telehealth appointments. Nectar is a consumer healthcare provider with no public developer API surface; it was backed by Obvious Ventures, Juxtapose, and Harmony Partners.

providers.name: Pair Team
providers.description: Pair Team, PBC is a healthcare care-coordination company that pairs clinical care teams with technology to deliver comprehensive care management for underserved and vulnerable populations. It runs Enhanced Care Management for Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) members and a Medicare support program, coordinating housing assistance, food access, behavioral and mental health support, appointment scheduling, medication management, and transportation for people managing chronic conditions and social determinants of health. Its Flora AI care advocate helps triage and connect members to resources and escalates to clinical staff. Backed by Craft Ventures. Pair Team publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Parallel Learning
providers.description: Parallel Learning is a special education services and staffing platform that connects K-12 schools and districts with a nationwide network of licensed clinicians for the remote delivery of specialized student support. Through its proprietary, HIPAA/FERPA-compliant Pathway platform it delivers virtual psychoeducational and neurodevelopmental assessments, speech-language therapy, behavioral and mental-health counseling, specialized instruction in reading, writing, and math, and executive-function coaching, pairing secure teletherapy with progress tracking and clinical oversight so districts can meet compliance requirements and improve student outcomes. The company serves thousands of students across dozens of states and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Pawp
providers.description: Pawp is a veterinary telemedicine membership service that gives pet owners 24/7 access to licensed veterinary professionals via text, video, and phone. For a flat annual membership, members get unlimited on-demand consultations with vets, nurses, and technicians who each carry a minimum of five years of clinical experience, along with personalized care plans and follow-up guidance for both emergencies and routine questions. Pawp operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) with no public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and lux-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: PB Health
providers.description: PB Health (PB Healthcare Service Pvt Ltd) is an India-based consumer healthcare network offering end-to-end care through a single app - online doctor consultations, hospital visits and admissions, lab tests and radiology scans, medicine ordering, diabetes and obesity management, preventive health packages, and structured home care and recovery. The platform spans top specialities including cardiology, gastroenterology, orthopaedics, pulmonology, internal medicine, gynaecology, ENT, paediatrics, and minimal-access and bariatric surgery, and helps families coordinate their complete health and insurance journey. PB Health is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) and website; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: PeopleOne Health
providers.description: PeopleOne Health is a nationwide provider of value-based, employer-funded advanced primary care, delivering comprehensive physical and mental health services with no copays, deductibles, or coinsurance for members. Its model pairs dedicated care teams with a prevention-first approach to lower total cost of care for self-funded employers while improving member health outcomes, and it was named a 2024 Best Nationwide Primary Care Provider by the Validation Institute. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV, PeopleOne Health operates as a healthcare services provider rather than an API platform: member access is delivered through a healow-based patient portal and a member portal, and no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer documentation is published.

providers.name: Phil
providers.description: PHIL (PHILRx) is a healthtech company operating a digital hub and direct-to-patient platform that helps pharmaceutical brands maximize prescription starts, insurance coverage, affordability, and medication adherence. Its all-in-one platform connects pharma manufacturers, patients, and healthcare providers to streamline the prescription access experience, run affordable direct-to-patient and cash-pay programs, and improve commercial performance across the medication access journey. PHIL is a portfolio company of Uncork Capital. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Plenna
providers.description: Plenna is a women's healthcare provider operating a network of integrated medical clinics across Mexico City, redefining health for women across every life stage. Its services span gynecology, maternity and prenatal care, fertility, menopause, contraception, gynecological surgery, psychology, nutrition, laboratory studies, vaccines and lactation support, delivered across six physical clinics (Tlalpan, Coapa, Del Valle, Polanco, San Angel and Satelite) and through Portal Plenna, a patient portal and iOS/Android mobile app for scheduling appointments, virtual consultations, test results, prescriptions and pregnancy tracking. Plenna is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Provide
providers.description: Provide is a financial services division of Fifth Third Bank offering banking and financing built specifically for owners of professional practices — dental, medical, veterinary, optometry, childcare, financial advisory, funeral, and insurance businesses. The company provides conventional and SBA loans to start, acquire, or expand a practice, alongside a full suite of customized banking products. Provide was acquired by Fifth Third Bank and operates as a specialty lending and banking brand. Surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors; it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Radish Health
providers.description: Radish Health is a healthcare company that provides employers with a modern employee health benefit, pairing each member with a dedicated care team and physicians who handle medical issues directly or coordinate specialist referrals. The service emphasizes direct-access primary care over phone, video, and in-person visits, with rapid response times and appointment coordination aimed at reducing employer healthcare costs while improving the patient experience. Radish Health is delivered through patient-facing web and mobile apps (iOS and Android) and an employer benefits program; it is a Techstars portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass, Radish Health publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation — this profile captures its identity, legal/support surfaces, and domain security posture only.

providers.name: Rezilient Health
providers.description: Rezilient Health is an employer-sponsored primary and specialty care provider that combines physical CloudClinics with telehealth to deliver unlimited, zero-cost care to employees on behalf of employers, health plans, health systems, and brokers. Its hybrid CloudClinic model pairs on-site medical staff with remote physicians and connected diagnostic equipment so members can access in-person and virtual visits, with the goal of lowering total healthcare spend and improving clinical outcomes. Rezilient offers patient-facing web and mobile apps for scheduling and care, but publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the honest result is that Rezilient operates a consumer/enterprise healthcare service rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Salvo Health
providers.description: Salvo Health is a virtual care company delivering continuous gastrointestinal and metabolic care through integrated, tech-enabled clinical teams. Its platform pairs registered dietitians, licensed nurses, and behavioral health specialists with a patient mobile app and remote patient monitoring to manage conditions including IBS, obesity, GLP-1/anti-obesity therapy, and fatty liver disease (MASH/MASLD). Adherence data and monthly patient reports are integrated directly into provider EHR systems. Salvo Health is a portfolio company of Threshold Ventures. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this record captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Season Health
providers.description: Season Health is a food-as-medicine platform that helps people living with chronic conditions eat well and live well. It connects patients with registered dietitians, personalized nutrition and meal plans, and medically-tailored groceries and meals, and works with health plans and care providers to deliver nutrition care as a covered benefit. The consumer and provider experiences run through app.seasonhealth.com; the company is a HIPAA-covered digital health service. Season Health is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs — api.seasonhealth.com is a private application backend — so this profile captures the company's real public web properties rather than an API program.

providers.name: Sira Medical
providers.description: Sira Medical develops augmented reality software that transforms 3D radiological imaging into patient-specific holographic models projected onto real-world backgrounds. Delivered through head-mounted AR devices (such as Microsoft HoloLens) and mobile platforms, the technology helps surgeons perform preoperative planning with greater confidence, clinicians educate patients with understandable visualizations, medical schools train students on patient-specific anatomy, and medical-device makers design and validate implants. The company is backed by 500 Global, Eileses Capital, UCSF Innovation Ventures, and Microsoft for Startups. Sira Medical operates as a clinical AR software vendor and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sofía
providers.description: Sofía is a 100% Mexican health insurance company (aseguradora) offering medical coverage for individuals, families, and businesses, delivered primarily through a mobile app with plans that carry no deductibles. Regulated in Mexico by the CNSF, Secretaría de Salud, and CONDUSEF, and backed by Index Ventures. This is a consumer/enterprise insurance provider surfaced as a portfolio-company lead; a live probe of the public surface found no developer program, API, or /.well-known/ discovery documents, so this profile remains identity-only pending any future API exposure.

providers.name: Solace Health
providers.description: Solace Health (solace.health) is a US healthcare navigation and patient-advocacy platform that matches patients and family caregivers with dedicated advocates, many covered by insurance, to handle administrative tasks, coordinate care and referrals, and fight for approvals and treatments. Advocates support members by video, phone, text, and email nationwide across a range of insurance plans, with a member app at app.solace.health. The company is venture-backed (IVP among its investors). As of this enrichment pass, Solace publishes a patient-facing service only and exposes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Sondermind
providers.description: SonderMind is a Denver-based mental health company operating a measurement-based behavioral healthcare platform that connects people to licensed therapists and psychiatrists who have availability, accept insurance, and specialize in their needs. It offers virtual and in-person therapy and psychiatry across all 50 U.S. states, along with enterprise offerings for health systems, physician practices, payers, and Veterans. SonderMind is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a consumer and clinician web platform (with a member/provider sign-in at api.sondermind.com) but no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; this repository tracks SonderMind's public web, content, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sunnyside
providers.description: Sunnyside is a digital health platform for alcohol moderation, founded in 2020, that helps members cut back on or quit drinking through personalized weekly plans, drink tracking and analytics, human text-based coaching, habit-building exercises, and a supportive community. Its separate Sunnyside Med telehealth service connects members with licensed providers who can prescribe compounded naltrexone. Sunnyside is a consumer mobile app and telehealth service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Synapticure
providers.description: Synapticure is a virtual-first telehealth company delivering comprehensive, specialist neurology care for people living with neurodegenerative and complex neurological conditions, including ALS/PLS, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, dementia, Huntington's, and multiple sclerosis. Founded in 2021 by ALS patient Brian Wallach and caregiver Sandra Abrevaya, the company integrates 24/7 access to neurologists, behavioral health (psychiatry and therapy), care coordination, genetic testing, clinical-trial navigation, and insurance support into a single virtual care experience available in all 50 states and covered by most insurance. It is accredited by The Joint Commission and maintains AICPA SOC 2 compliance. Synapticure operates as a healthcare provider and does not publish a public developer program or API; this profile was surfaced as a GV portfolio company and enriched with real, published identity and security signals.

providers.name: Tend
providers.description: Tend (Tend Dental) is a consumer dental-care company offering modern, judgment-free dentistry through a network of design-forward "studios" across New York City, Boston, Atlanta, Washington DC, Nashville and Connecticut. The brand pairs a soothing in-person studio experience and top-rated dentists with a fully online booking and patient-intake flow at hellotend.com. Services span preventive hygiene, family dental care, cosmetic dentistry, veneers, Invisalign and clear aligners, orthodontics, dental implants, endodontics, sedation and emergency care. Backed by GV and Redpoint Ventures. This is a consumer web/ booking business with no public developer API surface; the profile is enriched with identity, security-posture and discovery-probe artifacts only.

providers.name: Tooth Fairy
providers.description: Toothfairy is a UK dental telehealth platform billing itself as the world's first dentist on-demand, pairing registered dentists with a consumer mobile app to deliver teeth straightening with clear aligners, prescription teeth whitening, and same-day emergency video dental consultations 24/7, plus employer dental plans for businesses. The company is health-regulated in the UK, backed by Seedcamp, and ships its product as iOS and Android apps with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: VetSource
providers.description: VetSource is a veterinary technology and pharmacy company founded in 2008 that delivers a suite of pharmacy, technology, and business services for the pet health industry. Its offerings span home-delivery prescription management (an online pharmacy and prescription workflow that lets veterinary practices prescribe and fulfill medications with compliance and revenue tools), the Vet2Pet client-engagement platform (a custom-branded app connecting practices with pet owners for communication, reminders, loyalty, and telehealth), and data/analytics services that provide industry benchmarking and practice performance insights. VetSource serves veterinary practices and pet owners across North America. No public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation is published; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: ZOE
providers.description: ZOE (joinzoe.com, canonically zoe.com) is a personalized nutrition and health science company founded on data from one of the largest nutrition research studies in the world. Its membership program pairs at-home testing (gut health, blood sugar, and blood fat responses) with an AI-powered app that scores meals, tracks personal food responses, and delivers science-backed dietary guidance. ZOE also sells consumer products including the Daily30+ whole-food supplement and Gut Health products, and publishes the ZOE Science & Nutrition podcast. The company operates as a direct-to-consumer health brand rather than an API provider, and is tracked here as a Balderton Capital portfolio company; it currently exposes no public developer platform, API, or developer portal.

providers.name: Headspace
providers.description: Headspace (formerly Headspace Health, the 2021 merger of Headspace and Ginger) is a mental health and wellbeing company best known for its consumer meditation, mindfulness, and sleep app, alongside an enterprise business that delivers coaching, therapy, and psychiatry to employers, health plans, and healthcare providers. The consumer app offers guided meditation, sleepcasts, focus music, and mindful movement, while Headspace for Organizations provides clinical mental healthcare and EAP-style benefits at scale. Headspace does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or SDKs; integrations are handled through enterprise partnerships (for example health-plan and benefits-platform data exchanges), and its engineering work is visible through the headspacemeditation GitHub organization. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio lead and enriched with the public identity, security posture, and web properties that could be verified.

providers.name: Owletcare
providers.description: Owlet (Owletcare) is a baby-monitoring technology company that builds connected-nursery hardware and companion apps for parents. Its flagship Dream Sock is marketed as an FDA-cleared smart baby monitor that tracks a sleeping infant's pulse rate, oxygen levels, movement and sleep patterns, alongside the Dream Sight HD video monitor and the combined Dream Duo system. Products pair a wearable/camera with the Owlet Dream mobile app for real-time wellness insights and notifications. The consumer storefront at owletcare.com runs on Shopify; sign-in is handled by Shopify's Customer Account API (OIDC/OAuth), and Owlet does not currently publish a first-party developer API program. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched from Owlet's public web surface.

providers.name: Tryadonis
providers.description: Adonis (Adonis Technology, Inc., tryadonis.com redirects to adonis.io) is a healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) software company that applies AI to medical billing. Its platform connects in real time with a practice's existing EHR, practice-management, billing, and patient-portal systems to surface revenue-related insights, automate claims and billing workflows, and reduce manual work for revenue teams. The company is backed by Homebrew. This is a B2B SaaS product with a private, authenticated product API (api.adonis.io) and a customer app (app.adonis.io); it does not currently operate a public developer program, OpenAPI documentation, or API portal.

providers.name: 7 Cups
providers.description: 7 Cups is an online emotional-support and mental-health service that connects people seeking support with a network of trained volunteer Active Listeners for free, confidential one-on-one chats available 24/7, alongside paid access to licensed therapists and a Premium self-help experience of guided "paths" and lessons. Founded by psychologist Glen Moriarty and backed by Initialized Capital, 7 Cups also licenses branded instances of its platform to businesses, universities, and health organizations. The company operates a consumer website and mobile apps; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner developer portal, so this profile captures its public web, support, policy, and security surface rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Caer
providers.description: Caer, Inc. is the company behind YUMI (helloyumi.com), a direct-to-consumer children's nutrition brand that makes nutritionally-engineered organic snacks for babies, toddlers, and kids. The product line includes toddler bars, squeezable smoothies-to-go, freeze-dried smoothie melts, super/breakfast bars, and soft-baked cookies, all formulated as function-first, nutrient-dense, organic, dairy-free, gluten-free, and clean-label. YUMI sells through its own WooCommerce storefront, Amazon, and select retail, offering one-time purchases and recurring subscription memberships. Backed by 500 Global. This profile was seeded as a venture-portfolio stub; it is a consumer packaged-goods e-commerce brand with no first-party public developer API, so most API-artifact scoring dimensions are not applicable.

providers.name: Decorte Future Industries
providers.description: Decorte Future Industries (DFI) is a UK healthtech company building AI that extracts clinical health signals from sound. Its technology turns the microphone in an ordinary smartphone into a screening device, analyzing audio to detect signs of heart, breathing, brain, and gut conditions at a standard targeting in-clinic specialist examinations. DFI's first commercial product, Sonus Health, is a veterinary heart-screening platform: clinics and pet owners record 30 seconds of heart sound from dogs (cats and horses coming soon) with a phone, and AI returns heart rate, heart rate variability, murmur detection, and a composite Heart Health Score in seconds, with a full report reviewed by a board-certified veterinary cardiologist within 48 hours. Sonus Health ships as iOS and Android apps for pet owners and a web dashboard for veterinary clinics.

providers.name: Meditopia
providers.description: Meditopia is a holistic mental-wellbeing platform founded in 2017 that blends psychology, technology, and wellness to support the mental, emotional, and physical health of individuals and organizations. For consumers it ships a meditation and mindfulness mobile app (sleep programs, guided meditations, personalized assessments, self-guided content) available in nine-plus languages and used by 40+ million people across 60 countries. For organizations it offers Meditopia for Work: a modern Employee Assistance Program (EAP), 1-on-1 expert sessions, a WellnessPass benefits platform, online trainings, and Soul, an AI wellbeing coach. Meditopia is backed by Creandum. The company operates a consumer mobile app and a B2B web platform; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile was surfaced as a Creandum portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: MicroTech Medical
providers.description: MicroTech Medical (Hangzhou) develops user-friendly diabetes glucose monitoring devices — blood glucose monitoring systems (BGMS), the AiDEX continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system, the Equil patch insulin pump, a closed-loop artificial pancreas, point-of-care testing (POCT), and LinX. Its AiDEX API Platform (aidexapi.microtechmd.com) is a self-service developer portal that registers developers and issues API credentials for accessing blood glucose data resources from AiDEX CGM devices, with separate global and China regional endpoints. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Pointone
providers.description: PointOne is an AI-powered legal practice management platform that automates time entry, billing compliance, and analytics for law firms. Its products include PointOne Time (automatic cross-device time capture with AI-generated narratives), PointOne Review (pre-bill review with AI markup and collaboration), and PointOne Intelligence (time analytics and resource-allocation insights), along with automatic enforcement of Outside Counsel Guidelines. The platform syncs with billing systems including Aderant, Clio, Filevine, QuickBooks, Actionstep, Elite 3E, Surepoint, MyCase, and LeanLaw, and serves 200+ law firms. PointOne is backed by Bessemer, Y Combinator, General Catalyst, and 8VC. No public developer API is currently published; integrations are delivered as pre-built connectors.

providers.name: Spill
providers.description: Spill is a UK-based employee assistance programme (EAP) that delivers mental health support to employees directly inside the tools teams already use, such as Slack and Microsoft Teams. The platform offers same-day, message-based counselling, structured multi-session therapy courses for specific mental health conditions, drop-in group sessions, manager mental-health training, and self-guided wellbeing content, all through a single subscription. Spill serves over 600 companies on month-to-month terms and is backed by Seedcamp. It is a B2B software-as-a-service wellbeing product rather than an API provider; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK has been published.

providers.name: Vitrue Health
providers.description: Vitrue Health is a London-based, Techstars-backed digital health company providing an AI-powered musculoskeletal (MSK) and workplace ergonomics platform. Its VIDA product uses camera-based AI assessments to automate Display Screen Equipment (DSE) compliance, deliver personalized pain-management pathways, and give employers analytics through a VIDA Co-Pilot dashboard, reporting an average 34% reduction in MSK pain. The platform integrates with HR systems, learning management systems, and SSO/provisioning identity providers, but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Blink Health
providers.description: Blink Health is a healthcare technology company that operates BlinkRx, a digital pharmacy platform connecting patients, prescribers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers to simplify prescription access, fulfillment, and affordability. The platform streamlines the path from a provider writing a prescription to a patient receiving medication at a transparent price, with copay support, home delivery, and manufacturer-sponsored programs. Backed by 8vc, Blink Health runs consumer-facing prescription-savings tools and a provider/pharma-facing BlinkRx offering. No public developer API program or documentation was found during enrichment; a live undocumented API host exists at api.blinkhealth.com.

providers.name: Doctolib
providers.description: Doctolib is a European e-health company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Levallois-Perret, France, operating across France, Germany, Italy and the Netherlands. It provides an online medical appointment-booking platform and practice-management software used by patients and by hundreds of thousands of healthcare professionals and facilities. Its product surface spans appointment booking, telehealth/video consultation, patient messaging, clinical software, patient billing, and the Doctolib Connect integration and single-sign-on layer. Doctolib exposes a partner/integration API via an authentication-gated developer portal (developers.doctolib.com); it publishes an RFC 9116 security.txt and runs a public YesWeHack bug-bounty program, an Atlassian Statuspage, and an open-source GitHub organization, but does not publish a public OpenAPI specification, first-party API SDK, or hosted MCP server.

providers.name: Accolade
providers.description: Accolade is a personalized healthcare and benefits navigation platform for employers and health plans. It pairs members with a care team of advocates, registered nurses, physicians, and mental-health specialists to help them understand their benefits, find in-network care, book appointments, and manage chronic and complex conditions. Accolade combines this human advocacy with virtual primary care, expert medical opinion, and mental-health services delivered through its member web and mobile apps. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. Accolade is a member-facing benefits platform and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Baba
providers.description: Baba Care, Inc. is a healthcare company that provides patient advocacy and care-navigation services for Medicare beneficiaries in the United States. Operating under the tagline "Healthcare simplified," Baba pairs each member with a dedicated advocate who handles their healthcare headaches — coordinating care, benefits, and administrative tasks — with the service covered by Medicare. The member experience is delivered through a login-gated web application at baba.care; the company publishes no public developer or API surface at this time. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Besoundbreast
providers.description: BeSound (Besoundbreast) is a women's-health technology platform offering modern, radiation-free breast imaging using ABUS ultrasound to help find cancers that mammograms can miss, particularly in women with dense breast tissue. BeSound connects patients with independent partner medical groups who deliver the imaging; results reach a secure patient portal within 24-48 weekday hours. Screening breast ultrasound is $349, with locations in Los Angeles (Melrose Ave) and Beverly Hills. BeSound is a consumer healthcare service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the machine-readable llms.txt it publishes for AI agents.

providers.name: Cerebral
providers.description: Cerebral is an American telehealth company providing online mental health and wellness care, including therapy, counseling, psychiatric evaluations, and medication management delivered through its website and mobile app on a subscription basis. Founded in 2020 by Kyle Robertson and Ho Anh, the company treats conditions such as depression, anxiety, insomnia, ADHD, and substance use disorder. Cerebral is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, which led a $300M Series C in December 2021 valuing the company at roughly $4.8B. Cerebral is a direct-to-consumer product and does not publish a public developer API or programmatic surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public company and website properties.

providers.name: Claritypediatrics
providers.description: Clarity Pediatrics is a virtual pediatric telehealth clinic that diagnoses and treats ADHD, anxiety, and childhood obesity in children ages 5-17, currently serving families in California and Texas. It combines clinical evaluations, medication management, and evidence-based behavioral programs — Behavioral Parent Training (BPT) and RUBI for ADHD, the SPACE program and a Teen Anxiety Program for anxiety, and lifestyle medicine for obesity — delivered by licensed multispecialty clinicians through video visits and weekly group sessions. It is a direct-to-consumer healthcare platform (parent app + provider referral) with no public developer or API surface at this time. Backed by Homebrew; added to the API Evangelist network from VC-portfolio discovery and enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: Conceive
providers.description: Conceive is a telehealth platform for fertility and pregnancy support. It offers 24/7 text access to fertility and pregnancy nurses, coaches, and dietitians, personalized fertility coaching, fertility test interpretation, virtual video visits with providers, expert-led community events, and an educational library. Membership is delivered through Conceive Plus and Conceive Premium tiers. The company is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. As a consumer telehealth app it publishes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its published identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Dawaai
providers.description: Dawaai is Pakistan's leading digital healthcare platform, operating a licensed online pharmacy alongside telehealth and diagnostic services. Founded on a licensed retail pharmacy (License #1265, 2014) and headquartered in Karachi, Dawaai lets patients order authentic prescription and OTC medicines for temperature-controlled doorstep delivery, book doctor and mental-health consultations, order home-based lab tests and checkups, arrange home nursing and medical services, and subscribe to chronic-care programs for diabetes and obesity. It is a LegitScript-certified healthcare merchant that sources directly from manufacturers and distributors, with qualified pharmacists handling procurement, storage, and dispensing. Dawaai is backed by 500 Global and operates across Pakistan, including Karachi and Rawalpindi. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network via the venture portfolio pipeline; Dawaai publishes no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: Dawn
providers.description: Dawn (Sleepedy, Inc. dba Dawn) is a digital-health company offering a clinician-guided Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) program delivered through a mobile app. The service pairs users with licensed sleep coaches and therapists for weekly video sessions and between-session chat, daily 5-7 minute sleep lessons, live sleep-performance insights, and weekly progress reports, with the goal of treating primary and chronic insomnia and reducing reliance on sleep medication. Dawn is in-network with major U.S. insurers (Aetna, Anthem, Cigna, United Healthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield) and offers an employer/enterprise workplace-wellness program. Backed by Kindred Ventures. Dawn publishes a consumer app and marketing site but no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Finni Health
providers.description: Finni Health is a telehealth company that connects families of children on the autism spectrum with Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapists and mental health providers. Operating across more than 30 states, Finni offers both in-home and in-clinic ABA therapy with flexible scheduling, handles insurance coordination and billing for its provider network, and gives parents a portal for progress tracking and family-led goal setting. The company positions itself as an operating platform for ABA practices as well as a care provider for families, but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Five Lives
providers.description: Five Lives is a health-technology company building evidence-based digital tools for dementia prevention and brain health for adults aged 50 and over. Founded by former Peak brain-training leaders Xavier Louis (CEO) and Sylvain Piquet (COO), the fully remote company operates two consumer mobile apps: Five Lives Brain Health, a prevention app available since 2021 with cognitive tests, brain games, and lifestyle tracking across five pillars (nutrition, sleep, physical activity, mood and social connection, and mental stimulation); and Five Lives Care, an evidence-based memory and autonomy programme for people aged 60+ launched in January 2026 and developed with leading memory centres in the UK and France. Its work draws on the FINGER study and the Lancet Commission's modifiable dementia risk factors, with research partners including the University of Oxford, Trinity College Dublin, the FINGER Brain Health Institute, Dementias Platform UK, and the Gerontopole d'Ile de France. Backed by Speedinvest. Five Lives does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Frontera
providers.description: Frontera (Frontera Health) is an AI-assisted clinical documentation company for behavioral health. Its software automates assessment and diagnosis report writing for Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) and clinical psychologists working in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and autism care, cutting report time from 6-10 hours to 2-3 hours. The platform pairs a BCBA-trained AI Assessment Builder and Diagnosis Builder with digital phenotyping, and is delivered as a HIPAA-compliant web application (customer login at portal.fronterahealth.com) rather than a public API. Frontera is a venture-backed portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer and security surface; as of this pass Frontera publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP server.

providers.name: Kindara
providers.description: Kindara is a fertility-awareness and reproductive-health company offering a digital fertility charting system across web (app.kindara.com) and iOS/Android mobile apps. It lets users track basal body temperature, cervical fluid, and menstrual cycle data to understand their fertility, time conception, or practice fertility-awareness-based birth control. Kindara pairs its charting app with the Wink basal thermometer and was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a consumer-facing femtech product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Lucid Lane
providers.description: Lucid Lane (now operating as Skyler Health) is a telehealth mental health platform delivering virtual talk therapy and counseling for mental health conditions, an AI-powered coaching companion, and guided meditation and mindfulness content through its Listen Therapy service. Originally founded to help patients taper off opioids and manage medication dependence during and after surgery, the company has since broadened into remote behavioral and mental health care delivered to members, employers, clinics, and providers. It is a consumer- and employer-facing care service with no public developer or API surface; member access is via the Skyler Health member portal. Backed by Accel and Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Milu Health
providers.description: Milu Health is a health technology company that pairs a virtual care team with an AI engine to help employees and their families get higher-quality healthcare at a lower cost. Founded in 2023 by Sasha Gribov and Gautam Kumar, Milu integrates directly with electronic health record (EHR) data from tens of thousands of provider groups and health systems to proactively flag medication issues, care gaps, fairly priced and high-quality doctors, incorrect medical bills, and more affordable medications. The platform also ingests an employer's health plan and benefits so it can notify members when an existing benefit could help. Milu is offered through employers and benefits advisors as well as directly to individuals. The company raised a $4.8M seed round led by a16z Bio + Health in March 2024. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company; Milu does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Mindbloom
providers.description: Mindbloom is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company offering at-home ketamine-assisted therapy for anxiety, depression, and PTSD, combining psychiatric clinician oversight, guided therapeutic sessions, and peer support. Clients complete a psychiatric evaluation, receive either sublingual tablets or subcutaneous injectable treatments, and are supported through a structured program with monitoring and integration guidance. The company reports having facilitated over 200,000 ketamine therapy sessions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer platform, or developer documentation — Mindbloom is a consumer healthcare service, not an API provider.

providers.name: Musely
providers.description: Musely is a telehealth platform, founded in 2012 by Jack Jia and Carrie Jiao and based in San Jose, California, that connects patients with U.S. board-certified dermatologists for personalized, prescription-strength skincare and related care. Patients share skin concerns online, physicians craft personalized treatment plans, and freshly compounded formulas are shipped to the patient. Since pivoting from a wellness community to prescription skincare in 2019, Musely has expanded into hair loss, hormonal/menopause health, and longevity, serving more than 1.2 million patients. Musely is a consumer/health company in the API Evangelist network; it operates as a direct-to-consumer web and mobile telehealth experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Offcall
providers.description: Offcall is a career and practice platform for physicians, backed by Bloomberg Beta. It provides confidential, anonymous physician salary and compensation benchmarking, and a verified clinician-to-clinician patient referrals network with HIPAA-compliant messaging for care coordination, delivered through web and mobile (iOS and Android) applications. Offcall does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; this profile was surfaced through the Bloomberg Beta portfolio and enriched with the identity and domain-security signals that are publicly available.

providers.name: Optimal
providers.description: Optimal is a preventive-health and longevity company based in Mexico City, backed by 500 Global, operating across Latin America (Mexico, Colombia, and Peru). Optimal offers a consumer blood test that analyzes more than 300 biomarkers and uses AI to surface problems before symptoms appear, positioning itself as a predictive health platform (branded "health OS") that integrates biological data, wearable metrics, behavioral patterns, and medical history into longitudinal health models to identify risk before it becomes disease. The company sells directly to consumers via a web app and subscriptions and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Poppins
providers.description: Poppins is a French digital health company that develops a clinically validated digital therapeutic (DTx) for children aged 7-11 with dyslexia. Classified as a Class I medical device under EU Regulation 2017/745, the mobile application delivers home-based, game-based training sessions of about 20 minutes per day, 3-5 times per week, targeting phonological awareness, reading speed, and visual attention span. Poppins complements in-person speech therapy, supports speech-language pathologists through professional accounts, and partners with insurers. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Poppins publishes a consumer and healthcare-professional web/mobile product but no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Q Bio
providers.description: Q Bio is a Redwood City, California health-technology company offering the Q Exam and the Q Bio Health Dashboard, sold directly at its clinic and through enterprise partners. The Q Exam is a comprehensive preventive-health assessment that combines whole-body non-contrast MRI, 120+ blood biomarkers, analysis of 163 risk-relevant genes, wearable data, medical history, and board-certified physician review into a single longitudinal health baseline. Imaging is quantified by Constellation, the company's FDA-cleared AI image-analysis software that segments organs and measures anatomy, and results are stored in the Q Bio Health Dashboard for year-over-year comparison. Q Bio is a portfolio company of a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Signos
providers.description: Signos is a metabolic health technology company founded by Sharam Fouladgar-Mercer and Bill Tancer that pairs a continuous glucose monitor (CGM) sensor with an AI-powered mobile app to help people understand their individual metabolic responses to food and make data-driven lifestyle changes for weight management. In August 2025 Signos received FDA clearance as the first over-the-counter glucose monitoring system for weight loss, making it available without a prescription to adults not on insulin. The platform integrates with the Dexcom Stelo sensor, Apple Health, Google Health Connect, smartwatches and smart scales, delivers real-time glucose insights, personalized meal and movement recommendations, registered-dietitian support, and daily and weekly metabolism scores, with optional GLP-1 medication access through partner healthcare providers. Signos was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). It is a consumer-facing product and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Sprinter Health
providers.description: Sprinter Health is an in-home preventive and diagnostic healthcare company that pairs trained community health workers ("Sprinters") who visit patients at home with a virtual team of physicians, nurses, and care navigators. Its hybrid Sprinter Care+ model delivers vitals, blood draws, ECGs, cancer and diabetic screenings, wellness visits, medication reconciliation, care-gap closure, health risk assessments, and social-needs screening, and partners with health plans such as Humana, Molina Healthcare, and Anthem. Backed by a16z, Accel, General Catalyst, and GV. No public developer or API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's identity, security posture, and legal/trust properties.

providers.name: Standard Practice
providers.description: Standard Practice builds voice AI for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) teams. Its AI agents place and handle outbound phone calls to insurance payers to automate administrative work — claim status follow-up, benefits verification, prior authorization, and EDI enrollment — so billing teams can scale collections and get paid more, faster. The platform is delivered as a private, login-gated web application. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Wing Venture Capital and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: The Helper Bees
providers.description: The Helper Bees is an Austin-based aging-in-place technology company that operates one connected platform linking benefits, in-home service providers, and support so older adults can safely age at home. Its products include Care Concierge human guidance, an Aging-in-Place Marketplace for OTC products and nonmedical services (home care, safety modifications, meals, transportation), the Helpful benefits card, digital invoicing and claims processing for home and facility care, and digital nurse eligibility assessments for long-term care insurance. The company runs one of the nation's largest networks of vetted in-home care agencies and sells to Long-Term Care Insurance, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid plan administrators. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. The Helper Bees publishes member and provider applications (the api.thehelperbees.com app host, the myhomealign.com provider portal, and mobile apps) but does not currently expose a public developer program, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs.

providers.name: TrueCare24
providers.description: TrueCare24 is a nationwide care platform providing care professionals and services for home and business. Its offerings span in-home care, on-demand healthcare staffing, visiting nurses, behavioral health and counseling, and workplace health programs including flu vaccination, diabetes screening, and COVID-19 testing and vaccination services. A 500 Global portfolio company, TrueCare24 operates customer dashboards and a provider portal but publishes no public developer program or API.

providers.name: Tuli
providers.description: Tuli Health operates a UK-wide network of over 300 high-street pharmacies as local diagnostic hubs, making clinical services - primarily blood testing and phlebotomy - accessible in every neighbourhood so people can get care close to home. It offers healthcare providers three models - One Network (white-label phlebotomy), One Solution (end-to-end test kits, draws and lab analysis), and an Enterprise tier with custom integration. Tuli exposes an API and web portal for booking and managing tests, though public developer documentation is not yet published.

providers.name: Visby Medical
providers.description: Visby Medical is a molecular diagnostics company that has miniaturized the gold-standard PCR laboratory onto a single-use, palm-sized point-of-care device, delivering lab-quality results in about 30 minutes without any instrument, sample transport, or lab infrastructure. Its consumer offering (sold direct at visby.com) is an FDA-authorized at-home women's sexual health test that detects Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, and Trichomoniasis, paired with same-day telehealth consultation on a positive result. Visby also builds point-of-care PCR platforms for clinical and respiratory pathogen testing. The company is backed by venture investors including Amplify Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks Visby Medical as a company; the business is a hardware diagnostics and direct-to-consumer commerce operation and does not publish a first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Weekend Health (Found)
providers.description: Weekend Health, Inc. (operating as Found / Found Health) is a consumer telehealth company offering personalized, science-based weight-loss care, including GLP-1 and other obesity medications, clinician oversight, coaching, and habit-change support delivered direct-to-consumer and through employer and health-plan channels. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal is published as of this enrichment pass; the profile carries the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Alem Health
providers.description: AlemHealth is an AI-powered teleradiology and medical imaging platform that unifies image acquisition, diagnostic reading, reporting, and analytics into a single cloud system used by 500+ radiologists across 20+ countries. Its product suite includes Connect PACS (cloud image archiving with an FDA-approved diagnostic viewer), FrontDesk RIS scheduling, a referring-physician Referral Portal, a patient QR-access app, and the AlemBox gateway and AlemHub reporting-server hardware. AI features cover automated report drafting, quality-assurance scoring, laterality-mismatch detection, and ICD-10 tagging, metered via an AI-tokens model. For providers, AlemHealth supports bi-directional HL7, FHIR, and API integrations plus standard DICOM connectivity to sync orders, patient demographics, and finalized reports with existing EMR/EHR and PACS systems.

providers.name: Caresense Pte. Ltd.
providers.description: CareSense Pte. Ltd. (CareSense.ai) is a Singapore-based preventive digital health company building AI-powered health coaching. Its flagship product is Mandy, a 24/7 AI health coach delivered over chat and voice, paired with the CareSense.ai app — a personal health dashboard covering nutrition, exercise, sleep and stress — and integrated health services including blood testing and telemedicine. The company sells both to individuals and to enterprise teams as a workplace wellbeing programme. CareSense was incorporated in Singapore on 14 June 2024 (UEN 202424008M), registered at 160 Robinson Road #14-04, and was founded by Lucas Ngoo, co-founder of Carousell, and Julian Koo, founder of the home-care platform Jaga-Me. As of this enrichment pass CareSense publishes no public API, developer portal, API documentation or SDKs; its technology surface is consumer and enterprise applications fronted by a Vanta-hosted trust center.

providers.name: Casana
providers.description: Casana (Casana Care) is a Rochester, New York digital-health company building passive, in-home remote patient monitoring hardware. Its flagship Smart Seat (formerly the Heart Seat) is a toilet-seat replacement that captures vital signs — heart rate, heart-rate variability, blood-oxygen (SpO2), respiration rate, blood-pressure insights, and sit-to-stand power — during normal bathroom use, with no wearables, no daily charging, and explicitly no camera or microphone. Readings sync to companion iOS, Android, and web apps for patients, families, and caregivers. The company operates in the digital health, remote patient monitoring, and connected medical-device space and is backed by General Catalyst and Kaiser Permanente. As of this profile Casana publishes a consumer product, companion apps, and legal/privacy pages, but no public developer program, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Medeloop
providers.description: Medeloop is an AI platform for the clinical research lifecycle, describing itself as an operating system for clinical research that spans grant discovery and funding, real-world evidence generation from patient data, and delivering actionable intelligence at the point of care. Its products include Medeloop Analytics (AI agents that analyze EHR, claims, and registry data without requiring users to code), EvidenceKit (analytics paired with all-payer claims data), Medeloop Grants (AI-assisted grant discovery and proposal writing), and Medeloop Care (population health and care management). The platform is federated (compute moves to the data, which stays in the customer's infrastructure), CDM-agnostic (Epic, Cerner, Meditech, OMOP, i2b2, or custom schemas), and model-agnostic (routing tasks across OpenAI, Anthropic, or DeepSeek), with multi-cloud deployment across AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premise. It serves pharmaceutical and life-sciences companies, health systems, and clinical researchers. As of this enrichment pass Medeloop publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; its documentation host (docs.medeloop.ai) is gated behind Okta authentication and its analytics application is a private client login.

providers.name: Tigerconnect
providers.description: TigerConnect is a healthcare clinical communication and collaboration (CC&C) platform used by 7,000+ healthcare organizations to unify secure messaging, clinical collaboration, alarm management, physician and nurse scheduling, patient engagement, nurse call, and pre-hospital care-team coordination on one activation layer. It integrates with 200+ medical devices and EHR systems and adds an AI orchestration engine (CareConduit) that routes alerts and workflows to the right clinical role at the right time. TigerConnect is recognized as a leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Clinical Communications and Collaboration. The company publishes end-user product release notes, an SLA, and legal terms, but exposes no public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Aluna
providers.description: Aluna is a digital respiratory health company behind an FDA-cleared, portable Bluetooth spirometer and companion mobile app that let people with asthma, COPD, and cystic fibrosis measure lung function (FEV1) at home and share the results with their care teams. The platform pairs a hospital-grade sensor with a gamified app and machine-learning analytics to encourage proper technique, track symptoms, triggers, and medications, and surface trends that help clinicians intervene before an exacerbation. Founded by Charvi Shetty and Inderjit Jutla out of UC Berkeley's bioengineering program, Aluna raised a $15.3M Series B and is a Matrix Partners portfolio company; the product is now operated under Huma Therapeutics. Aluna publishes consumer, clinical-provider, and clinical-trial surfaces but no public developer API.

providers.name: Bioniq
providers.description: Bioniq is a personalized nutrition and supplement company founded in London in 2019 that combines individual biomarker and blood-test data with a proprietary algorithm to formulate customized vitamin and mineral blends delivered as Swiss-made granules. Its consumer product line spans Bioniq GO (wellness-assessment based), Bioniq PRO (blood-test driven), and Bioniq Essential, supported by iOS and Android apps for tracking health and supplement routines. Bioniq is a portfolio company of HV Capital and now operates within Herbalife. It exposes consumer web, mobile, and partner/affiliate surfaces but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: MTN OPS
providers.description: MTN OPS is an American-owned outdoor performance nutrition and lifestyle brand founded in 2014 and headquartered in Fruit Heights, Utah. The company develops, manufactures, and sells energy and nutrition supplements (pre-workout, protein, hydration, creatine, and energy bars) alongside apparel and gear for hunters, tactical professionals, military, and outdoor athletes, running a "Conquer Hunger" program that donates one meal for every order placed. MTN OPS is a direct-to-consumer, internet-first retailer operating on the Shopify platform and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. It publishes no bespoke developer API; the only machine-readable surfaces on its domain are the Shopify New Customer Accounts OIDC discovery documents and a Shopify-generated agent-commerce llms.txt. This profile was surfaced as a Norwest portfolio lead and enriched from the provider's live public surface.

providers.name: Teladoc Health
providers.description: Teladoc Health is a global leader in whole-person virtual care, providing on-demand healthcare, expert medical opinions, mental health services, chronic condition management, and integrated virtual care solutions to consumers, employers, health plans, hospitals, and clinicians. The company connects patients with clinicians via mobile, web, phone, and video to deliver 24/7 access to care across a wide range of conditions. Teladoc Health offers integration capabilities for partners and health systems, but does not publish a publicly accessible developer API portal with open documentation.

providers.name: Amperos
providers.description: Amperos provides AI-powered insurance claims management and revenue recovery for healthcare providers, using agentic AI to recover insurance revenue end-to-end and drive more collections, faster. The platform automates denial management, claims processing, and collections workflows while keeping human experts in the loop for complex cases, and integrates with major EHR / practice-management systems including eClinicalWorks, Athenahealth, NextGen, Epic, ModMed, and Dentrix. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. Amperos exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time; the product is delivered as a managed service and web application.

providers.name: Amperos Health
providers.description: Amperos Health (Amperos) is an AI-native insurance revenue recovery platform for healthcare providers. It uses agentic AI together with experienced revenue cycle management (RCM) specialists to run the full insurance collections process, from claim submission through denial resolution to payment. The platform automates first-touch routine tasks, works complex denials with specialist oversight, and adapts configurable workflows to each organization's procedures across specialties including orthopedics, cardiology, behavioral health, DME/HME, ophthalmology, anesthesiology, dermatology, urology, dental, and oncology. Amperos reports outcomes such as higher claim recovery, reduced accounts receivable backlogs, and lower cost to collect for the healthcare providers it serves. The company is backed by Uncork Capital and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company. Amperos currently exposes a marketing and demo-request surface rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public web properties and security posture.

providers.name: AnswersNow
providers.description: AnswersNow is a virtual Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy provider for individuals with autism, delivering personalized, evidence-based care from board-certified behavior analysts (BCBAs) through its proprietary telehealth platform. Families access one-on-one therapy sessions, caregiver and parent training, and individualized treatment plans remotely, expanding access to ABA care in areas with limited in-person availability. AnswersNow accepts major insurance carriers including Medicaid, is BHCOE accredited and a CASP member organization, and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company. This profile has been enriched with company identity and domain-security posture; AnswersNow publishes a consumer web application (web.getanswersnow.com) but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: August AI
providers.description: August AI is a consumer health-AI companion that helps people understand their symptoms, lab reports, prescriptions, and medications, and connects them to licensed physicians through asynchronous, chat-based telehealth visits. Founded in 2022 by Anuruddh Mishra after a four-month misdiagnosis, August operates as a 24/7 health assistant available on iOS, Android, and WhatsApp, storing lab reports and conversation history in long-term memory to deliver personalized guidance. The service pairs a free AI symptom-assessment experience with paid online doctor consultations from board-certified MDs licensed across all 50 US states. August reports serving millions of users across 160+ countries in 30+ languages, and publishes medical benchmarks including 100% accuracy on the USMLE, 97.4% on MedQA, 99.4% on lab-report document processing, and 100% precision/recall on emergency escalation. It is backed by Accel and Claypond Capital. August is a consumer application and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Curve Health
providers.description: Curve Health is a New York City-based digital health technology company, founded in 2020, that delivers a virtual care and telemedicine platform purpose-built for skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) and senior care. The platform unifies telemedicine, a health information exchange, predictive analytics, and smart billing into a single system so nurses, physicians, behavioral health providers, and facility operators can deliver care in place and reduce avoidable hospital transfers. Curve Health reports enabling 150,000+ remote care visits and an 80% reduction in hospitalizations for partner facilities, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Morningside. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web and product-documentation surface; Curve Health does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: Datavant
providers.description: Datavant is a United States health-data logistics company, formed from the 2021 merger of Datavant and Ciox Health, that connects and de-identifies healthcare data across a "network of networks" spanning 350+ real-world data partners, 80,000+ hospitals and clinics, and a majority of the largest US health systems. Its core capabilities are privacy-preserving record linkage using Datavant tokens, HIPAA Expert Determination and de-identification, medical record retrieval / release of information, and real-world evidence generation for life sciences, payers, providers, and government. Datavant's integration surface is enterprise and partner/contract gated - an access-controlled API host exists at api.datavant.com (returns HTTP 403 to anonymous callers) but Datavant does not publish a self-serve public developer portal, a downloadable OpenAPI specification, or a FHIR CapabilityStatement. Home market is the United States.

providers.name: Eden
providers.description: Eden is a Latin American healthcare technology company providing cloud-based medical imaging and radiology software for hospitals, clinics, and diagnostic centers. Its platform includes Eden PACS (a cloud picture archiving and communication system and DICOM viewer), Eden Management (scheduling, referral, and operational workflow tools), Eden Intelligence (data-driven analytics for medical institutions), and Eden Creator (an AI assistant for drafting diagnostic impressions). Eden is backed by Sierra Ventures and serves medical institutions across Latin America. No public developer API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Harbor Health
providers.description: Harbor Health is a Central Texas healthcare company building a vertically integrated "pay-vider" model that combines primary care, specialty care, and health coaching clinics with its own commercial and individual health insurance plans, so the same organization both delivers and covers care. Founded in 2022 by Dr. Clay Johnston (founding dean of UT Dell Medical School), Tony Miller, and Eric Scott, the company operates clinics and Express Care walk-in locations across the Austin, Dallas, El Paso, and San Antonio metros, and is pursuing a value-based care model for the commercial market. It is backed by General Catalyst, 8VC, and Alta Partners. Harbor Health publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public web properties (member portal, plans, blog, privacy and terms) for discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: Lumeon
providers.description: Lumeon is a clinical automation and care orchestration platform that uses intelligent automation and real-time data integration to remove inefficiencies from care-coordination processes. It lets health systems scale best-practice care pathways across the enterprise so clinicians can focus on patients while operational cost falls and outcomes improve. Lumeon serves 70+ health systems globally — including Optum, NYC Health+Hospitals, and the NHS — and is now part of Health Catalyst. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published; this profile captures the company identity and its security and compliance posture.

providers.name: MedHOK (Hearst Communications)
providers.description: MHK (formerly MedHOK), part of Hearst Health, is a healthcare technology company providing a unified SaaS platform for health plans and payers. Its CareProminence suite spans utilization management, care management, complaints/appeals and grievances, pharmacy management, population health and quality management, and interoperability (the MHK Interop Suite), while its MarketProminence suite covers enrollment and member maintenance, premium billing, financial reconciliation, and member web portals. MHK helps Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plans streamline operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve the member experience. The MHK Interop Suite supports FHIR, SMART on FHIR, Da Vinci, and CMS-0057 interoperability requirements. MHK publishes HITRUST and ISO 27001 certification and NCQA prevalidation. The company operates a public marketing and resource site but does not publish a public developer portal or API program.

providers.name: Myndlift
providers.description: Myndlift is a digital neurofeedback and mental-health company that pairs a consumer/clinical mobile app with a wearable EEG brain-sensing headband (Muse) to deliver therapist-guided, personalized brain-training programs. The platform provides brain mapping and assessments, gamified real-time neurofeedback sessions, progress tracking, and remote-monitoring dashboards used by both individuals and mental-health practitioners for attention, anxiety, stress, sleep, and peak-performance goals. Backed by 500 Global, the company reports 26,000+ members and more than one million neurofeedback sessions delivered. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record with verified identity links.

providers.name: OneHealthCompany
providers.description: The One Health Company is a Palo Alto veterinary precision-oncology company, best known for its FidoCure platform, that brings human-grade precision cancer medicine to dogs. FidoCure sequences a dog's tumor with next-generation DNA sequencing, matches the cancer-driving mutations to targeted therapies, and gives veterinarians an individualized treatment plan grounded in the world's largest proprietary canine cancer dataset (billions of data points across a network of more than 1,300 veterinary clinics). The company was founded in 2015 by Christina Lopes and Ben Lewis on the "One Health" thesis that treating cancer in companion dogs also advances real-world evidence for human oncology. It is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z bio), Y Combinator, Polaris Partners, Borealis Ventures, Lerer Hippeau and Tau Ventures. As of this profile the company exposes a consumer and veterinarian web experience (including a veterinarian login portal) but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Pathai
providers.description: PathAI is a healthcare artificial-intelligence company transforming pathology through machine learning. Its AISight Image Management System (IMS) and the AISight Link open API deliver AI-assisted disease detection, biomarker quantification, fields-of-interest and AI Impressions, and laboratory workflow integration for pathologists, hospital and reference labs, and biopharma research partners. AISight Link is an enterprise interoperability surface that connects AISight with third-party AI algorithms and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS/LIMS) over REST and HL7; PathAI does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs. The company is ISO 27001 certified and operates a vulnerability disclosure program. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 8vc.

providers.name: Pendulum
providers.description: Pendulum (Pendulum Therapeutics, pendulumlife.com) is a microbiome-management and metabolic-health company that develops clinically validated probiotic supplements built on novel, patented anaerobic microbial strains such as Akkermansia muciniphila. Its consumer products - including Glucose Control, Metabolic Daily, Akkermansia, and a GLP-1 probiotic - are formulated to fuel and maintain the gut lining, support immunity, relieve gas and bloating, and help keep blood glucose in a healthy range, differentiated by double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trials rather than off-the-shelf probiotic blends. Pendulum is a direct-to-consumer health and supplement brand and is a portfolio company of DCVC; it does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Petco Animal Supplies
providers.description: Petco Animal Supplies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Petco Animal Supplies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Plenful
providers.description: Plenful is an AI-powered workflow automation platform for pharmacy and healthcare operations, founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York City. The platform automates complex, high-ROI administrative pharmacy workflows — 340B audit and optimization, 340B referral capture, rebate and Maximum Fair Price (MFP) reconciliation, benefits verification and prior authorization, and infusion order intake — using large language models and machine learning tuned to each organization's data. It ingests PDFs, flat files, APIs, HL7 feeds, and databases, supports unlimited organizational logic rules, and serves 100+ healthcare organizations including Prisma Health, Renown Health, Temple Health, Cencora, and Samaritan Health Services. Plenful is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Notable Capital (formerly GGV Capital), SUSA Ventures, TQ Ventures, and Waterline Ventures. Plenful ships an enterprise SaaS product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Rex Inc
providers.description: Rex Inc, operating as Rex.fit (BabylonAI Inc.), is a Y Combinator (W23) health and fitness company building AI-powered, fully automated nutrition tracking.
