providers.description: Journey (Journey Meditation) is a workplace mental health platform that delivers preventive Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services to enterprise organizations. Rather than the reactive model of traditional EAPs, Journey uses AI-powered risk detection (Journey Signal) to identify emerging mental health issues before they escalate and connects employees to clinicians across 190+ countries in 100+ languages. Its offerings include Journey Proactive EAP, the Journey LIVE guided-meditation and wellbeing experience, and a Mental Health Certification training program. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer or API surface has been found; this profile is maintained as a company lead and refreshed by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: KeyCare
providers.description: KeyCare is a telehealth platform that connects health systems to a national network of independent, virtual-first care providers through deep Epic EHR integration. Built on Epic using CareEverywhere, MyChart, Telehealth Anywhere, and Book Anywhere workflows, KeyCare lets member health systems extend their own Epic instance to on-demand urgent care (24/7/365 across all 50 states), behavioral health, neurology, primary care, and expanding specialties such as rheumatology, cardiology, and maternal care. The company serves health systems including Allina Health, Memorial Healthcare, Ochsner Health, WellSpan, and Confluence Health. KeyCare is backed by 8VC. This profile has no public API or developer surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Layer Health
providers.description: Layer Health is a healthcare AI company building a clinical intelligence platform that reads longitudinal medical records at scale to automate labor-intensive clinical workflows for health systems. Its products span clinical registry abstraction automation (cardiovascular, surgical, and oncology registries), clinical pathways that surface guideline-aligned care opportunities and eligible patients, site-of-care optimization, and automated quality measurement of custom clinical variables. The company positions clinician-validated AI as an embedded workflow layer rather than a standalone tool, citing 50%+ time savings on registry abstraction, and works with health systems including Johns Hopkins Medicine, Intermountain Health, MultiCare, and White Plains Hospital. Backed by GV. As of this enrichment pass Layer Health publishes a marketing and company site only and exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Lina
providers.description: Lina is a medical coworking company providing space, community, and support for independent healthcare practitioners in private practice. Founded by Vicrum Puri and Rachel Puri, Lina offers turnkey private office suites alongside on-demand medical, therapy, and bodywork spaces that are HIPAA and OSHA compliant and bookable by the hour or by the day. Locations operate in NoMad and Grand Central in New York City and Aventura, Florida, with expansion announced for Washington DC, West Palm Beach, the Upper West Side, and Brooklyn. Lina is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company. It operates a Webflow marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Lotus Health AI
providers.description: Lotus Health AI (branded Lotus AI, at lotus.ai) is an AI-powered consumer healthcare platform delivered through an iOS app that pairs artificial intelligence trained on medical evidence with licensed physicians to provide personalized medical care. The service offers AI-guided care plans built from a member's health data, prescriptions sent to any pharmacy in the United States, lab ordering across 6,000+ test sites nationwide, centralized medical-record management, and 24/7 availability. The company is a portfolio company of Kleiner Perkins in the healthcare sector. As of this profile the company exposes a consumer mobile product and physician tooling (Cortex) but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Luna
providers.description: Luna is an in-home physical therapy company that dispatches licensed physical therapists to patients' homes for 1:1 treatment sessions covered by insurance, including Medicare and major commercial plans. The company supports orthopedic, sports medicine, neurologic, post-surgical, and geriatric rehabilitation across a nationwide network of thousands of therapists, reaching roughly 85K patients and more than 1.2M in-home PT visits in 2024. Luna was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a consumer healthcare service with no public developer or API program at this time.

providers.name: Manatee
providers.description: Manatee is a digital mental health company delivering family-centered virtual therapy for children, teens, and their parents. It pairs licensed therapists with dedicated care navigators to provide evidence-based treatment (CBT, DBT, and family-systems therapy) for kids ages 5-18 and counseling for caregivers, coordinated through a family app and covered by most major insurance plans across multiple U.S. states. Backed by Techstars, Manatee operates as a consumer telehealth service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Marathon Health
providers.description: Marathon Health is a healthcare services company delivering advanced primary care and occupational health to employers, labor unions, health plans, and brokers/consultants. It operates onsite, nearsite, and network health centers plus virtual primary care, spanning preventive care, mental health, musculoskeletal treatment, lifestyle and medication management, value-driven referrals, and population health management to improve employee health outcomes while lowering total healthcare cost. Backed by NEA. As of this enrichment pass Marathon Health publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or event/webhook surface.

providers.name: MedeAnalytics (JLL Partners)
providers.description: MedeAnalytics is a healthcare data and analytics company serving health insurance payers and risk-bearing provider organizations, positioning itself as a healthcare performance improvement company that turns claims, clinical, and operational data into actionable insight and measurable financial and quality results. Its platform spans Health Fabric, an AI-powered healthcare data fabric; AI Studio for ready-to-use and custom predictive models; Managed Action for workflow automation; and Integrated Analytics modules with embedded ROI tracking. Solution areas include MLR optimization, HEDIS/Stars quality performance, utilization and network management, value-based care, revenue cycle, population health, and social determinants of health (SDOH). The company was surfaced from a VC portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Medefer
providers.description: Medefer is a UK digital-first managed clinical services company that connects patients directly with consultant specialists remotely and safely, working in partnership with the NHS. Its virtual, consultant-led model triages and manages patient referrals through remote review, coordinating in-person tests and treatment through a trusted local and national partner network only when they are needed. Backed by Seedcamp, Medefer brings hospital-level specialist expertise into patients' homes and communities, reducing waiting times for NHS and self-pay patients across a range of specialties. Medefer operates a patient/clinician application and a private internal application backend (api.medefer.com) rather than a public developer API program.

providers.name: MediBuddy (fka DocsApp)
providers.description: MediBuddy (formerly DocsApp) is India's largest digital healthcare platform, operated by Phasorz Technologies Private Limited and founded in 2013 by Satish Kannan and Enbasekar Dinadayalane. Launched as DocsApp in 2015 for online doctor consultations, it merged with and rebranded to MediBuddy in June 2020. The consumer platform delivers teleconsultations (chat, video, voice) across 20+ specialties, at-home lab-test bookings, online medicine delivery covering 95%+ of Indian pin codes, and health checks. It is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Quadria Capital and Rebright Partners. No public developer / API program was found; product access is via the consumer web and mobile apps.

providers.name: Medical Informatics
providers.description: Medical Informatics Corp. (MIC) is a Houston, Texas healthcare technology company behind the FDA-cleared Sickbay platform for virtual and remote patient monitoring. Founded in 2010 by Emma Fauss and Craig Rusin, Sickbay archives, aggregates, and transforms otherwise unrecorded high-resolution physiological waveform data across disparate, vendor-neutral biomedical devices to enable anytime, anywhere remote monitoring, TeleICUs, alarm management, workflow automation, and patient-centered predictive analytics and AI across the continuum of care. The company is backed by DCVC, Intel Capital, Catalio Capital, and the Texas Medical Center. Sickbay is a clinical SaaS platform with no public developer API surface; integration is delivered through the vendor as HL7/device connectivity.

providers.name: Mirvie
providers.description: Mirvie is a clinical-stage women's health company founded in 2018 and based in South San Francisco, California, pioneering the early prediction of pregnancy complications. Its proprietary RNA platform uses a simple maternal blood test and machine learning to read tens of thousands of molecular messages from mother, baby, and placenta, revealing the underlying biology of each pregnancy months before symptoms appear. Mirvie's first product, the Encompass preeclampsia test, pairs a novel blood test that predicts personalized preeclampsia risk with a preventive care plan and received FDA Breakthrough Device designation. The company is backed by General Catalyst, GV, Mayfield, Khosla Ventures, Foresite Capital, and Decheng Capital. Mirvie operates consumer and clinical web properties (mirvie.com and encompasstest.com) but publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Mural Health
providers.description: Mural Health is a clinical research technology company whose Mural Link platform manages the clinical trial participant experience end to end. Founded by the team that created ClinCard, Mural Health provides integrated participant payments across 10+ global methods (Venmo, PayPal, Zelle, Revolut, bank transfer, virtual and physical prepaid debit cards, and check via mail), in-app travel and rideshare coordination (Uber, Lyft), participant messaging and calendar syncing, and real-time satisfaction analytics for research sites and sponsors. The company works with leading pharmaceutical sponsors, CROs, and site networks to reduce trial dropout and administrative burden across studies in 75+ countries, and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. Mural Health does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; system integrations are delivered through partnerships (e.g., ClinOne, Clinical Ink).

providers.name: Netsmart Technologies
providers.description: Netsmart Technologies is a healthcare software and services company serving community-based care providers across human services, post-acute care, home care and hospice, public sector, and physical rehabilitation. Its CareFabric platform unifies electronic health records (EHR) such as CareRecord, myAvatar, and myUnity with workforce management, revenue cycle, analytics, and interoperability tooling. Netsmart is a founding member of the Carequality interoperability collaborative and became the first EHR built for human services and post-acute care to be designated a Qualified Health Information Network (QHIN) under TEFCA, exchanging clinical data via FHIR-based standards. The company publishes no public developer portal or API documentation; integration is delivered through its CareConnect interoperability services, the Netsmart Marketplace partner program, and direct engagement rather than a self-service public API.

providers.name: New Lantern
providers.description: New Lantern is a cloud-native, AI-native radiology platform that unifies the worklist, PACS/DICOM viewer, and AI-powered reporting into a single browser-based workspace, replacing the fragmented multi-system software stack most radiology practices run today. Its cloud-native DICOM viewer offers 3D/MPR/MIP reconstruction, mammography and PET/CT modes, and AI hanging protocols; its Curie AI reporting assistant drafts reports that a licensed radiologist reviews, edits, and signs; and NL-Vox provides radiology-tuned speech recognition, alongside intelligent worklist and case distribution, analytics, and native Epic/Oracle Health EHR integration. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, New Lantern is backed by a $19M Series A led by Benchmark and is FDA registered as a Class I medical image communications device (21 CFR 892.2020). New Lantern does not currently expose a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity and public web/security posture.

providers.name: Noah Medical
providers.description: Noah Medical is a surgical robotics company building the Galaxy System, a robotic-assisted bronchoscopy platform for interventional pulmonology. The system combines advanced imaging, precision targeting, single-use scope technology, and an adaptive workflow to deliver "tool-in-lesion" confidence for diagnosing lung nodules, improving diagnostic yield and workflow efficiency for physicians. Noah Medical is a medical-device manufacturer focused on clinical hardware and does not currently expose a public developer platform, API, or documentation surface; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a healthcare portfolio company backed by Hongshan (HongShan Capital / formerly Sequoia China).

providers.name: Nuevo Método
providers.description: Nuevo Método (NUME) is an international digital-health and corporate-wellness platform, headquartered in Mexico City and operating across 17 countries in Latin America and Europe. It helps insurers and enterprises deliver personalized wellbeing benefits to employees, customers, and their families across three pillars: mental health (psychology sessions, mindfulness, meditation, sleep tracking), physical health (24/7 virtual medical consultations, fertility guidance, menstrual-cycle tracking, health workshops), and lifestyle (personal-finance courses, financial advisory, and inspirational talks). The company runs a fully remote workforce and reports measurable client outcomes such as improved sleep, productivity, and employee retention. Founded and led by Dr. Ingrid Briggiler (CEO). No public API or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company's identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nym
providers.description: Nym is a healthcare technology company providing autonomous medical coding for health systems, hospitals, and physician groups. Its proprietary Clinical Language Understanding (CLU) engine reads clinical documentation and assigns accurate medical codes (ICD-10, CPT, and E/M) without human intervention, combining machine reading with transparent, rules-based coding logic rather than generic natural language processing. Nym automates revenue cycle management to reduce coding costs, accelerate billing, and improve charge capture across 400+ US healthcare facilities, and is used by health systems including OSF, Ochsner Health, Inova, and Henry Ford. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Nym does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Onco.com
providers.description: Onco.com is a comprehensive cancer care platform operated by Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd that connects cancer patients across India with oncologists and treatment services. The platform offers priority expert oncology consultations, pan-India cancer medicine delivery at discounted rates, diagnostic testing and imaging, curated treatment packages with negotiated hospital rates, and the CanWin peer support group for survivors and caregivers. Onco.com reports a network of 400+ oncologists and 23+ treatment centers, having served more than 100,000 patients. It also publishes extensive patient-education content covering many cancer types (breast, lung, blood, prostate, colon, and others) through its About Cancer library and blog. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company; the platform is consumer/patient facing and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: One Medical *
providers.description: One Medical (1Life Healthcare, Inc.) is a membership-based primary care organization delivering in-person and virtual healthcare across 25+ US cities. Members pay an annual fee for same/next-day appointments, 24/7 on-demand video visits, secure provider messaging, integrated lab services, and digital health records, with most major insurance plans accepted. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and is now owned by Amazon, which offers One Medical membership to Amazon Prime members. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; One Medical operates a consumer healthcare site and member app and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or /.well-known/ discovery surface.

providers.name: Ooda Health
providers.description: OODA Health is a healthcare technology company modernizing the business of healthcare by automating administration and payments between payers, providers, and patients. Its flagship platform, OODAPay, coordinates billing across all parties to give patients a single consolidated bill while reducing provider administrative burden and bad debt; OODA Optic extends its analytics and administrative tooling. OODA Health worked with payers and health systems including Anthem, CommonSpirit Health, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts and Arizona, Blue Shield of California, and Hill Physicians Medical Group, and was acquired by Cedar. The company was backed by Threshold Ventures. No public API, developer portal, or SDK surface has been identified.

providers.name: OpenLoop Health
providers.description: OpenLoop Health is a Des Moines, Iowa-based white-label telehealth infrastructure company that powers virtual care for digital health companies, health plans, diagnostic labs, retailers and pharmacies, and hospitals and health systems. Its platform bundles a nationwide clinician network (covering all 50 states and more than 500,000 patient visits per month), provider staffing, licensing and credentialing, payer coverage and revenue cycle management, diagnostic imaging, regulatory and legal support, and practice management, with AI-powered clinical operations across synchronous and asynchronous care. OpenLoop delivers its capabilities through EHR integrations and protocol-specific API integrations offered to partners via sales; as of this profile there is no publicly published API specification, SDK, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Oula Health
providers.description: Oula Health (Oula) is a modern maternity and women's health provider operating collaborative-care clinics in New York and Connecticut. Oula pairs OBGYNs with certified nurse midwives to deliver comprehensive support before, during, and after pregnancy — including preconception planning, prenatal and postpartum care, gynecology, and miscarriage care — and partners with health systems, employers, and payers to extend that model. It is a patient-facing healthcare provider and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Outcomes4Me
providers.description: Outcomes4Me is a digital health company providing a personalized cancer care navigation platform for patients. The consumer app delivers personalized treatment plans, symptom and medication management, and community support grounded in NCCN Guidelines, serving over 300,000 patients across 100+ cancer communities. Alongside the patient app, Outcomes4Me runs a For Life Sciences business that offers real-world outcomes data, precision content and marketing, and clinical-trial recruitment and patient-reported-outcomes support to pharmaceutical and diagnostics partners. Backed by Sierra Ventures. No public developer/API surface is published at this time; this profile has been enriched with the company identity and domain-security posture that are publicly available.

providers.name: Oxford Science Enterprises
providers.description: Oxford Science Enterprises (OSE) is an independent investment company and venture builder that transforms cutting-edge research from the University of Oxford into commercial companies tackling global challenges across deep tech, life sciences, and health tech. Operating on a "find, fund, build" model, OSE provides patient capital and hands-on company-building to Oxford science founders, backing 50+ flagship companies with a net asset value of around £1.3bn alongside 300+ co-investors. Notable outcomes include Oxford Ionics (acquired by IonQ) and Dark Blue Therapeutics. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; OSE is an investor and venture builder and does not publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Pedestal Health (formerly Target RWE)
providers.description: Pedestal Health, formerly Target RWE (and NoviSci), is a Durham, North Carolina real-world evidence and health-data company serving life sciences organizations and health systems. It generates regulatory-grade real-world evidence from large-scale observational data and longitudinal patient cohorts across hepatology, dermatology, and gastroenterology (including the TARGET-NASH, TARGET-Derm, and TARGET-Gastro registries), supporting clinical development, regulatory strategy, and care delivery. The company operates as a data, research, and services provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched from the company's public website (targetrwe.com now redirects to pedestalhealth.com).

providers.name: Pluro
providers.description: Pluro is India's fertility and IVF platform, built as a co-creation model with doctors for patients. It delivers personalised, evidence-based reproductive care through a growing network of 15+ clinics across India, combining advanced clinical science, AI-assisted embryology, standardised treatment protocols, and transparent pricing. Founded by Dr. Bhaskar Shah, Dr. Jaydeep Tank, and Dr. Parikshit Tank, Pluro raised a Rs 125 crore Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners in 2025. It offers IVF/ICSI, IUI, ovulation induction, and a range of diagnostic and surgical fertility treatments. Pluro publishes an llms.txt for AI agents but exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: PlushCare
providers.description: PlushCare is a telehealth and virtual primary care platform that connects patients with board-certified physicians for online doctor visits, available 24/7 across all 50 US states. Services include online prescriptions and refills, urgent care video visits, mental health care and therapy, weight-loss management including GLP-1 medications, chronic disease management, pediatric and preventive care, and sexual health. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in San Francisco, PlushCare accepts most major insurance and offers self-pay memberships. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GGV Capital and Lightspeed Venture Partners. As a consumer telehealth service, PlushCare publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its public web and domain-security surface.

providers.name: REEV
providers.description: REEV is a medical-technology company developing AI-powered wearable robotics for mobility recovery and neurological gait rehabilitation. Its REEV SENSE platform uses smart shoe- and leg-mounted sensors to analyze gait and visualize biomarkers in a mobile app, and its DREEVEN motorized knee-ankle-foot orthosis (KAFO) delivers robotic walking assistance personalized from REEV SENSE gait data. REEV serves outpatient clinics and rehabilitation centers treating stroke, multiple sclerosis, and paraplegia, and is backed by Techstars, NVIDIA Inception, and Bpifrance.

providers.name: Reliance Health
providers.description: Reliance Health (formerly RelianceHMO) is a healthtech company making quality healthcare accessible and affordable across emerging markets, with operations centered in Nigeria and expanding across Africa and the Middle East. It offers employer-sponsored and individual health plans covering preventative, emergency, and chronic care, telemedicine and doctor consultations through its mobile app, and a network of 3,800+ healthcare partners (hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and diagnostic centers). Reliance Health combines insurance, its own clinics, and technology to deliver an end-to-end care experience for businesses and their employees. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; the reliancehmo.com application backend (api.reliancehmo.com) is an internal web-app origin, not a documented public API.

providers.name: Remedee Labs
providers.description: Remedee Labs is a French medical device company founded in 2016 in Grenoble that develops millimeter-wave neuromodulation solutions for chronic pain management. Its flagship product is the Remedee wrist bracelet, which stimulates nerve endings to trigger endorphin release, paired with the myRemedee companion app and human coaching. The company markets two subscription solutions, FibroRem for fibromyalgia and NoviRem for osteoarthritis pain. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network; the product is consumer-facing and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Rippl Care *
providers.description: Rippl (Rippl Care) is a specialty healthcare company delivering value-based, virtual-first behavioral health and dementia care for older adults and their caregivers. Its clinical model spans medication assessments, personalized care plans, counseling, community-resource navigation, and safety guidance, partnering with health systems, providers, and payors. Rippl runs its patient portal on athenahealth and is backed by GV (Google Ventures); it has no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Route 92 Medical
providers.description: Route 92 Medical (r92m) is a neurovascular medical device company committed to improving outcomes for stroke and neurovascular patients through revolutionary procedural change. Its portfolio includes the FreeClimb System of access and aspiration catheters (models 54, 70, and 88), the HiPoint Reperfusion System built on the Monopoint Approach (under investigation in the SUMMIT MAX clinical trial), and the Ascent product line. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Route 92 Medical publishes a corporate marketing and clinical-evidence website but exposes no public developer, API, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Scarlet
providers.description: Scarlet is Europe's only Notified Body specialised in software and AI-based medical devices. Operating at scarlet.cc, Scarlet certifies Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) and AI as a Medical Device (AIaMD) under the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR), streamlining conformity assessment, CE marking, and certificate transfers for manufacturers who ship iteratively and release frequently. Backed by Creandum, Scarlet was built to bring modern, fast-moving regulatory certification to AI and software medical-technology companies. Scarlet is a regulatory and certification services provider; it currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Science 37 *
providers.description: Science 37 operates a decentralized, direct-to-patient clinical research platform — the first and only FDA-inspected direct-to-patient site — that delivers clinical trials to participants wherever they are. Its Metasite and Agile Clinical Trial operating model combine patient recruitment, research-grade nursing, telemedicine, eConsent, ePRO, wearable/device integration, and EHR data capture into a single end-to-end SaaS platform used by sponsors and CROs. Backed by GV and Lux Capital, the company has supported 200+ trials across many therapeutic areas. No public developer portal or API surface was found during enrichment (developer./api.science37.com do not resolve); this profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Second Nature
providers.description: Second Nature is a UK-based digital weight-loss programme that combines NHS-trusted, CQC-regulated clinical care with dietitian-led coaching and behaviour-change support. The service pairs weight-loss medication (including Wegovy, Mounjaro, oral semaglutide and Orlistat programmes) with personalised medication reviews, a mobile app for tracking, and a science-based content library of guides and member stories. It operates as a registered pharmacy, supports NHS referrals and partnerships, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Speedinvest. As of this enrichment pass Second Nature publishes a consumer marketing site and an llms.txt discovery file but exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Sensorum Health
providers.description: Sensorum Health is a healthcare technology company that provides home-based, fully passive sensor technology and integrated clinical services to identify and triage the earliest signs of health decline in older adults living with chronic conditions. The platform monitors patients 24/7 in their own homes without requiring wearables, smartphones, or WiFi, then coordinates clinical interventions when concerning health patterns emerge — with the goal of preventing avoidable hospital admissions. Backed by GV (Google Ventures). Added to the API Evangelist network as a company/provider record; no public API, specification, or developer program has been published as of this profile.

providers.name: Snout
providers.description: Snout provides affordable veterinary wellness subscription plans that help pet owners access preventive and routine care without financial stress, while enabling veterinary clinics to increase visit frequency and revenue. Clinics offer monthly membership plans covering unlimited exams and preventative care tailored to each pet's life stage (puppy, adult, senior), and receive upfront payment at the time of service. Snout supports partner practices with dedicated Clinic Success Managers, custom marketing, and staff training, serving 2,500+ providers nationwide. Backed by 500 Global. No public API, developer portal, or developer documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Strive Health
providers.description: Strive Health is a Denver-based value-based kidney care company that partners with health systems, nephrologists, and payors to deliver comprehensive care for patients across the kidney disease spectrum, from chronic kidney disease (CKD) and end-stage kidney disease (ESKD) through dialysis and transplant. Its model combines Population Health care teams, Strive Care Partners (nephrologist-led services), Kidney Heroes nurse-practitioner care teams, and the CareMultiplier machine-learning platform for personalized, predictive treatment planning. Strive reports outcomes including higher optimal dialysis starts, reduced hospitalizations and readmissions, and increased home dialysis adoption. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of NEA and Redpoint Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Strive Health publishes no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: SwipeRx
providers.description: SwipeRx (operated by mClinica Pte. Ltd., formerly mClinica Pharmacy Solutions) is the leading community and B2B commerce platform for pharmacies across Southeast Asia. Delivered as a mobile application, it connects a network of more than 300,000 pharmacy professionals and 50,000 retail pharmacies in Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand and Cambodia. The platform combines professional networking, accredited continuing professional development (CPD) education, industry news, a drug directory, adverse-event reporting, and B2B medicine purchasing (the Belanja marketplace) into a single app that digitizes a historically fragmented pharmacy supply chain. SwipeRx publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; its api.swiperxapp.com host is an undocumented private backend serving the mobile app.

providers.name: Synapsor
providers.description: Synapsor (legal entity Ottai Technology (Wuxi) Co. Ltd.) is a Chinese medical-device company based in Wuxi, Jiangsu that develops AI-powered, medical-grade smart wearable devices. Its flagship product is the Ottai continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system - a waterproof, calibration-free wearable sensor paired with a mobile app and AI assistant for 24/7 glucose tracking and diabetes management, sold in China and internationally via ottai.com. Investors include Qiming Venture Partners, Huatai Zijin Investment, Wuxi Industry Development Group, YuanBio Venture Capital, and Shunwei Capital. Synapsor publishes no public developer API, portal, or machine-readable API specifications as of July 2026.

providers.name: Talkiatry
providers.description: Talkiatry is an online psychiatry (telepsychiatry) platform that connects patients with in-network, employed psychiatrists and therapists for virtual mental health care. Patients begin with a free online assessment that matches them to a psychiatrist, then attend video visits for evaluation, medication management, and talk therapy. Talkiatry treats conditions including ADHD, depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, PTSD, and OCD, works with major insurance plans, and operates as a HIPAA-compliant, LegitScript-certified telehealth provider. The company is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass Talkiatry publishes a consumer telehealth website but no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tembo Health
providers.description: Tembo Health is a telemedicine practice (founded 2018) that partners with skilled nursing facilities and senior living communities to deliver 24/7 virtual specialty and urgent care to elderly residents. Its board-certified clinicians provide treat-in-place emergency medicine, psychiatry, cardiology, and dementia care, reducing avoidable ER transfers by roughly 75 percent, and the company works with senior-care operators and EHR platforms such as PointClickCare. Tembo Health is a healthcare services provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties.

providers.name: Trupanion
providers.description: Trupanion is a pet medical insurance provider for cats and dogs, best known for its patented software that pays participating veterinary hospitals directly at checkout (VetDirectPay) rather than reimbursing pet owners after the fact. Trupanion operates a partner developer portal (Azure API Management) that exposes Partner APIs for Quotes, Enrollments, and Offers, plus a Vet Portal / VetDirectPay integration used by veterinary practice management systems such as ezyVet, IDEXX, and DaySmart Vet. API access is gated - partners must be approved through Trupanion's Partner Program and are issued OAuth client credentials (client ID and client secret) plus a subscription key; the endpoint reference is not publicly published. The APIs listed here are modeled from Trupanion's public partner and portal materials, not from an openly documented API reference.

providers.name: VivorCare
providers.description: OncoveryCare (VivorCare) is the first virtual survivorship clinic for people living with and beyond cancer. Backed by Techstars, the company pairs survivorship-trained care teams with a virtual-first platform delivering physical and mental health support, personalized survivorship care planning, patient navigation to community resources and referrals, and survivor education. It partners with oncology providers such as New York Cancer & Blood Specialists (NYCBS) to extend post-treatment care. OncoveryCare operates a public website and blog but currently publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Well
providers.description: Well is a personalized health engagement platform for employers and their workforce, marketed as "your personalized daily health partner." It pairs an AI-driven health engine that delivers tailored interventions and behavior-change nudges with human "Well Guides," across a mobile and web experience, and ties outcomes to a performance-based ROI guarantee for the sponsoring employer. Well powers wellness programs, health challenges, biometric screenings, premium reductions, and rewards for large employer and benefits clients including Bank of America, USAA, Sam's Club, UNC Health, MGM, Regions, Amentum, and Octapharma. The company is backed by General Catalyst and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; enrichment found a public WordPress marketing/campaign presence at well.co but no public developer API, SDKs, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Wellxai
providers.description: Wellx (Wellxai) is a Dubai-based health insurtech company that transforms health insurance from reactive to proactive through AI-driven behavior change. Its consumer mobile app pairs behavioral science and gamification with wearable integrations (Fitbit, Apple Watch, Whoop) so members earn xCoins rewards by hitting health goals, step and sleep challenges, and wellness programs, then redeem them with marketplace partners. Wellx also sells to corporates and SMEs and partners with brokers and insurers, positioning healthier behavior as the driver of better-value health insurance. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company exposes consumer iOS/Android apps backed by a private API but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Zenyum
providers.description: Zenyum is a Singapore-founded, direct-to-consumer oral-care and dental company operating across Asia. Its flagship product is ZenyumClear invisible braces (clear aligners) delivered through a network of partner clinics, alongside a broader oral-care line that includes ZenyumSonic electric toothbrushes, ZenyumBright whitening strips, serums and pens, toothpastes, water flossers and floss. Zenyum sells online and through retail across Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam and Japan, and is backed by venture investors including Partech. As of this profile the company operates consumer e-commerce and clinic-partner surfaces but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or GitHub organization; this record captures its verifiable public web and domain security footprint.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Accompany Health
providers.description: Accompany Health is a value-based healthcare company that delivers integrated in-home and virtual care to patients with complex, chronic conditions, primarily those covered by Medicaid and Medicare. Its multidisciplinary care teams combine primary care, behavioral health, and social care, wrapping medical treatment with support for the social drivers of health. The company operates in Massachusetts, Michigan (Detroit), and Colorado (Denver), works with health plans and providers, and is HIPAA compliant. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IVP and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a marketing and patient-education website but no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Acme Markets
providers.description: Acme Markets is a regional supermarket chain founded in 1891 and headquartered in the U.S. Northeast, operating approximately 164 stores across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, New York, Connecticut, and Maryland. Acme is a banner of Albertsons Companies, Inc., one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States. The brand has no publicly documented developer program or public API: digital surfaces (store locator, loyalty program "ACME for U", FreshPass subscription, DriveUp & Go, delivery, pharmacy) are delivered through Albertsons-shared web and mobile platforms. The Android package ID (`com.safeway.client.android.acme`) confirms that the Acme app is built on the shared Safeway/Albertsons banner application, suggesting a shared backend API surface across Albertsons banners that is not externally published.

providers.name: Aletiq
providers.description: Aletiq is a French software company building a next-generation, AI-powered Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Product Data Management (PDM) platform for regulated manufacturers. The platform centralizes technical data (CAD files, drawings, bills of materials, configurations, and work instructions), enforces traceability and regulatory compliance, and automates business processes such as approvals, engineering change management, and project milestones. Aletiq emphasizes rapid deployment and high adoption across operational teams, and integrates with major CAD tools (SolidWorks, CATIA, Autodesk Inventor, Siemens NX, Creo) and ERP systems (SAP, Sage, Cegid, Infor, Odoo) via connectors and a custom-integration API. It serves aerospace and defense, medical devices, energy, electronics, automotive, and luxury-goods industries. Aletiq is backed by Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead profile.

providers.name: ConcertoCare
providers.description: ConcertoCare is a value-based healthcare provider delivering coordinated, in-home and virtual medical care to Medicare-eligible seniors and adults with complex, chronic, and behavioral health needs. Its interdisciplinary care teams of physicians, nurse practitioners, pharmacists, and social workers deliver house calls, medication management, behavioral and social health support, transportation and nutritional assistance, caregiver support, and advanced care and palliative planning, coordinating with a member's existing doctors and benefit plans. The company operates as a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST CSF certified organization and is a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures. It has no public API or developer program at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Focused Space, Inc.
providers.description: Focused Space, Inc. operates focused.space, a consumer productivity platform built around "body doubling" — a neuroscience-backed technique where people work silently alongside others to more easily enter and sustain a flow state. The service combines 100+ weekly live sessions hosted by real humans (available 24/7) with a custom focus-video platform, a goal-setting and task-tracking app, and a community aimed at creatives, builders, remote workers, and people with ADHD. Focused Space is a 500 Global (and E14 Fund) portfolio company. It ships web, iOS, and Android apps but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: Gireve
providers.description: Gireve is a B2B digital platform for electric-vehicle charging and new-mobility services, connecting charge point operators (CPOs), e-mobility service providers (eMSPs), and EV drivers across Europe. Its interoperability hub powers EV charging roaming, clearing and transaction settlement, Plug & Charge, smart charging, and mobility data services, spanning 680,000+ connected charging points and roughly one million monthly roaming transactions across 13,000+ signed agreements. Technical integration is delivered to connected operators over an OCPI-based hub through the Connect Place B2B platform; Gireve does not publish a public self-serve developer portal or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: IDEXX
providers.description: IDEXX Laboratories is a global leader in veterinary diagnostics, offering reference laboratory testing, in-house analyzers (IDEXX VetLab Station), diagnostic imaging (IDEXX Web PACS), and practice management software (Cornerstone, Neo, and ezyVet, which IDEXX acquired in 2021). IDEXX connects the practice to its diagnostic ecosystem through VetConnect PLUS - a diagnostic results and ordering platform - and through partner integration APIs for Web PACS imaging and reference/in-house lab results. These developer integrations are partner-gated - the developer portal at developer.vetconnectplus.com requires an authenticated login, and partner access is granted only after an approved IDEXX integration request. Web PACS API Partner integrations authenticate with OAuth 2.0-style credentials (Client ID, Client Secret, and Grant Type) issued by IDEXX customer support. IDEXX does not publish an open, unauthenticated API reference, OpenAPI description, or pricing; the logical APIs below are modeled from IDEXX's public product and integration pages, not from a public endpoint reference.

providers.name: Massive Bio
providers.description: Massive Bio is an AI-powered healthcare company that matches cancer patients with clinical trials. Its platform analyzes 500+ medical data elements — diagnosis, genomic profile, and clinical history — to deliver personalized trial-match reports within 24 hours, connecting patients, physicians, pharmaceutical sponsors, and research institutions. Products include a patient-facing matching service, the Trial Relay physician screening and referral tool, and iOS/Android mobile apps. The company reports 200,000+ registered patients and coverage of 19,000+ active oncology and hematology trials across multiple international markets. Massive Bio does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Numan
providers.description: Numan (trading as Vir Health Limited) is a UK-based digital healthcare and telemedicine company offering convenient, clinician-led care direct to consumers. Its services span weight-loss programmes (including GLP-1 medications such as Mounjaro and Wegovy), men's health (erectile dysfunction, hair loss, testosterone), women's health (menopause support), at-home blood tests and diagnostics, supplements, and one-off doctor consultations, delivered through its website and iOS/Android app. Numan is regulated by the Care Quality Commission and operates a GPhC-licensed pharmacy. It is a portfolio company of Anthemis. As of this enrichment pass Numan publishes no public developer API, SDKs, MCP server, or partner integration surface.

providers.name: Ollie
providers.description: Ollie (ollie.com, formerly myollie.com) is a direct-to-consumer pet health company that makes fresh, human-grade dog food tailored to each dog. Customers build a personalized meal plan from their dog's profile (breed, age, weight, activity, allergies), and Ollie delivers pre-portioned, chef-and-vet-developed recipes on a recurring subscription, along with app-based health tracking and check-ins. The company reports having served more than one million dogs. Ollie is a venture-backed consumer brand and a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; it operates as a subscription e-commerce and mobile-app business and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Akido Labs
providers.description: Akido Labs is a Los Angeles-based healthcare technology company re-engineering care delivery with artificial intelligence. Its flagship system, Scope AI, is a clinical decision support platform trained on large volumes of healthcare data using reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) to help physicians reach efficient diagnoses, order the right diagnostics, personalize treatment, and forecast health risks. Providers use Scope AI through the Akido Chart EMR to expand capacity for primary care and specialty visits. Akido also operates Akido Medical, a care network spanning dozens of locations and hundreds of providers serving hundreds of thousands of patients, with an emphasis on underserved and street-medicine populations. The company is venture-backed (including a Series B led by Oak HC/FT) and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Assort Health
providers.description: Assort Health builds an AI voice-agent platform purpose-built for healthcare practices, automating the full patient-access journey across the phone line and back office — 24/7 appointment scheduling and management, intelligent triage and call routing, patient intake and insurance verification, proactive outbound reminders and outreach, referral and fax automation, medication refill management, after-hours medical answering, and payment resolution. The agents are trained on 190M+ patient interactions spanning 23+ medical specialties and integrate with 15+ EHR/PMS platforms (with deep athenahealth support), personalizing each conversation with patient context, language preference, and care history. The company is venture-backed (Series C), with Lightspeed Venture Partners and Menlo Ventures among its investors. This API Evangelist profile was enriched from Assort Health's public web surface; the company publishes no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: Athos
providers.description: Athos is a sports performance technology company founded in 2012 and based in Redwood City, California, that builds athletic apparel with embedded surface electromyography (EMG) sensors. Its garments and snap-on Athos Core module capture muscle activity, effort, and motion data, streaming it over Bluetooth to a mobile app and coaching dashboard so athletes, trainers, and sports scientists can measure muscular exertion, fatigue, and return-to-play readiness in real time. Athos is a consumer and team hardware brand with no publicly documented developer API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: DietlyAPI
providers.description: Food & nutrition data REST API with 4.2M+ foods, calories, macros, 17 micronutrients, barcode lookup, and confidence-ranked full-text search. Data primarily from Open Food Facts (ODbL), EU-hosted, with key-optional read access.

providers.name: Glow
providers.description: Glow (glowing.com) is a women's health and reproductive-health technology company whose consumer mobile apps track periods, ovulation, fertility, pregnancy, and early baby development for a community of more than 25 million members. Its app suite spans Glow (ovulation and fertility), Eve by Glow (period tracking), Glow Nurture (pregnancy), and Glow Baby (infant development), and it layers AI-powered health insights through GlowGPT along with a Glow Premium subscription and a companion Glow Shop for hardware such as basal thermometers, test strips, and a smart breast pump. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network, Glow is a consumer app business with no public developer program: no API portal, developer documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface could be located during enrichment.

providers.name: Nix
providers.description: Nix (Nix Biosensors) develops wearable biosensor technology that analyzes sweat to deliver real-time hydration and electrolyte data. Its lightweight single-use biosensor patch continuously measures fluid and electrolyte losses and provides personalized hydration guidance to athletes, service members, and laborers. The company ships two consumer/enterprise offerings: Nix Solo, an individual app for self-monitoring hydration, and Nix Pro, a group-monitoring platform that lets coaches and supervisors track multiple users. Nix is a Techstars portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it operates a direct-to-consumer commerce and mobile-app business with no public developer program, API documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Stel
providers.description: Stel Life provides cellular-connected remote patient monitoring (RPM) infrastructure for healthcare. Its cellular-enabled vitals hubs and connected medical devices — blood pressure monitors, pulse oximeters, glucometers, thermometers, and scales — let patients transmit vital-sign readings to electronic health record (EHR) systems without WiFi, broadband, a smartphone, or app setup, targeting elderly, low-income, rural, and low-tech-literacy populations. Health systems and digital health organizations use Stel across the care continuum, from wellness and chronic-care management to hospital-at-home. Stel is backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Care GP
providers.description: Care GP is a Sydney-based healthcare technology company (Y Combinator Summer 2026) building a suite of AI agents that automate the administrative and operational work of Australian general practice clinics. Its products include Samantha (medical document allocation that files inbound emails, faxes, and scans), Veronica (24/7 inbound and outbound phone and booking management), and a Billing beta for billing and debt-collection automation. Care GP states it is ISO 27001 certified with onshore Australian data storage, multi-factor authentication, and encryption, and reports serving 400+ clinic operators. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a customer web application (agent.caregp.com.au) but no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: Charta Health
providers.description: Charta Health is a healthcare AI company (founded 2023) that provides AI-powered medical chart review and autonomous coding for provider groups, FQHCs, MSOs, health systems, and payers. Its platform streams charts in from hundreds of EHR, clearinghouse, and billing integrations, then audits every patient encounter pre-billing to generate codes, surface missed revenue and E/M leveling issues, identify HCC risk-adjustment codes with supporting documentation citations, reduce payer audit risk, and deliver data-driven provider feedback. Charta reports outcomes such as an 11% revenue uplift from scaling pre-billing review across 100% of encounters. Integrations are built per customer against the customer's EHR (e.g. athenahealth Marketplace); Charta does not publish a public self-serve developer API or portal.

providers.name: Express Scripts Holding
providers.description: Express Scripts is a pharmacy benefit management (PBM) company, now part of Cigna's Evernorth Health Services, that processes prescription claims and provides home delivery and specialty pharmacy services for clients including health plans and employers. The Express Scripts Developer Portal exists for partner and client integrations, but its API catalog is not openly published; access is gated to authenticated partners.

providers.name: 7 Cups
providers.description: 7 Cups is an online emotional support and mental health platform founded in July 2013 by psychologist Glen Moriarty (Y Combinator S13) and based in Palo Alto, California. It connects people seeking help with trained volunteer "listeners" for free, anonymous, 24/7 one-to-one active-listening chat, and also offers community forums, group support chat rooms, self-help growth paths, and affordable online therapy with licensed therapists via messaging. The service reports reaching tens of millions of people across roughly 190 countries, supported by hundreds of thousands of trained volunteer listeners, and sells organizational solutions for schools, employers, and health plans. 7 Cups does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Alodokter
providers.description: Alodokter is Indonesia's leading digital health and telemedicine platform, founded in 2014 and operated by PT Alodokter Teknologi Solusi. It connects tens of millions of monthly active users with tens of thousands of licensed doctors through chat-based consultations (Tanya Dokter), online and in-person doctor appointment booking, a large library of medically reviewed health articles and a symptom and disease encyclopedia, health protection and insurance products, and a health commerce surface for medicines and health products. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from the provider's own public web surface; Alodokter does not publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time, so this profile focuses on company identity, legal and support surfaces, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Altira Health
providers.description: Altira Health is a San Francisco-based healthcare technology company, founded in 2025, building AI-powered clinical follow-up for health systems. Its virtual clinical assistant, Lena, engages discharged and at-risk patients over voice and SMS, carries clinical context from the EMR across interactions, adapts across languages, escalates to human clinicians when needed, and documents findings directly back into the electronic medical record. The platform aims to recover clinician staff time and reduce hospital readmissions, and advertises API, webhook, dashboard, and analytics surfaces for connected EMR workflows (no public developer portal or API documentation is published as of this profile). Backed by Homebrew, Coalition, Focal, Stone Mountain Ventures, and Wireframe Ventures.

providers.name: BioInteractive Technologies
providers.description: BioInteractive Technologies operates Tenzr Health, a configurable digital care layer that helps health systems, rehabilitation programs, orthopedic groups, and therapy organizations extend care beyond the clinic. The platform gives patients structured guidance, education, tasks, check-ins, and recovery support while giving clinicians better visibility into patient progress, adherence, symptoms, and recovery signals across the episode of care. Tenzr supports musculoskeletal, orthopedic, and stroke rehabilitation, acquired brain injury recovery, outpatient therapy, Remote Therapeutic Monitoring, and hybrid or virtual care pathways. The company does not currently publish a public developer API or developer program.

providers.name: CopilotIQ
providers.description: CopilotIQ is a Nashville, Tennessee remote patient monitoring and telehealth company, founded in 2021, that delivers AI-driven chronic-condition management to seniors and Medicare members living with type 2 diabetes and hypertension. Through connected in-home devices, predictive analytics, and clinical automation it captures daily biometric readings and pairs them with weekly nurse coaching to catch anomalies early, reduce hospitalizations, and lower costs for health plans and providers. In October 2024 CopilotIQ merged with in-home care company Biofourmis. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and the SoftBank Vision Fund. CopilotIQ operates as a clinical care service and does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: Corner Health
providers.description: Corner Health is a primary care provider network operating in Arizona and Washington that connects patients with independent nurse practitioners and advanced practice registered nurses (APRNs). The company offers everyday and preventative care, chronic condition management, women's health, weight management and metabolic health, and hormone management, with longer appointment times, acceptance of major insurance plans, same-day/evening/Saturday availability, and continuity with the same provider across visits. It is a patient-facing healthcare service that publishes no public developer program, API, or technical documentation; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of homebrew and enriched with verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Data Sciences International
providers.description: Data Sciences International (DSI) is a preclinical research instrumentation and services company for in vivo physiology and translational research, operating as part of Harvard Bioscience. DSI builds implantable and external telemetry systems, respiratory measurement (plethysmography, airway mechanics, pulmonary function), inhalation and smoke-exposure systems, iPRECIO infusion pumps, and behavioral monitoring (VivaMARS), paired with analysis software (Ponemah, FinePointe, NeuroScore) and surgical, data-analysis, GLP-validation and training services. It is a laboratory-instrument and life-sciences vendor rather than an API provider; no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface is published. Surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Diana Health
providers.description: Diana Health (heydianahealth.com) is a women's healthcare provider offering personalized in-person and virtual care across the reproductive and primary health lifespan: maternity and prenatal care, labor and delivery, postpartum, gynecology, well-woman visits, menopause management, family planning and contraception, mental health, and wellness coaching, plus treatment for conditions such as endometriosis, PCOS, UTIs, and STIs. The company operates collaborative care-team clinics across Tennessee, Florida, and Texas, accepts most major insurance plans including Medicaid, and emphasizes longer appointments and whole-person (mental, physical, social) care. Diana Health is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. It publishes a consumer marketing and appointment-booking website but no public developer API; this profile is enriched with identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Easyhealth
providers.description: EasyHealth is a Los Angeles-based value-based care company that partners with health plans, provider groups, and risk-bearing entities to deliver proactive, in-home and virtual clinical care to Medicare, Medicaid, and Health Exchange members across 40+ states. Its Preventative Care Platform combines a hybrid visit model (in-home medical assistants paired with virtual nurse practitioners), Health Information Exchange integration, and real-time data dashboards for health plans to close HEDIS/care gaps, complete annual wellness visits, run preventive screenings, and manage chronic conditions such as cardiovascular, respiratory, diabetes, kidney, and behavioral health. EasyHealth emphasizes reaching underserved and hard-to-reach populations, claiming roughly 40% member engagement versus traditional sub-10% rates. The company is backed by Anthemis and QED Investors and is profiled here as an API Evangelist network company. EasyHealth publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: ethealthcare
providers.description: ET Healthcare (ethealthcare.com.cn) is an in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) company founded in 2008 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with operations in China. It develops immunodiagnostic systems built on its proprietary "lab-on-a-tip" technology, delivering central-lab-grade immunoassay performance in a near-patient setting. Its flagship Pylon platform (Pylon 3D automated immunoassay analyzers plus single-use Pylon Test Strips) runs cardiac, inflammation, fertility, infectious-disease, and tumor assays on whole blood, plasma, and serum. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners and other investors, ET Healthcare is a medical-device / clinical-laboratory instrument maker and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Fractyl Health
providers.description: Fractyl Health, Inc. (Nasdaq: GUTS) is a clinical-stage metabolic therapeutics company developing treatments that target the root causes of type 2 diabetes and obesity rather than managing symptoms. Its lead product, Revita, is an outpatient endoscopic procedure that resurfaces the duodenal lining to address a driver of metabolic disease, and Rejuva is an early-stage pancreatic islet-cell gene therapy platform designed for durable, one-time metabolic remission. The company is headquartered in Massachusetts and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and General Catalyst. Fractyl publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks its corporate, product, and investor web presence.

providers.name: Futuredontics
providers.description: Futuredontics is the parent company of 1-800-DENTIST, a dental marketing and patient-acquisition business with more than 38 years serving dental practices across the United States. Its core offerings are PatientLeads, a pay-per-call program that routes live new-patient calls (with AI-powered call screening) to practices on month-to-month terms, and PatientActivator, patient-engagement software that automates appointment reminders, review requests, and reputation management. The company reports serving 5,000+ practices, handling roughly 70,000 calls per month, and scheduling over two million appointments through its platform. Futuredontics is a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Fuze Health
providers.description: Fuze Health is a technology-powered healthcare company delivering comprehensive, patient-focused care at scale across three business units: FuzeRx (digital pharmacy and prescription fulfillment with patient engagement tools), Fuze Services (diagnostics, screening, clinical and genomics programs), and Fuze Technologies (proprietary healthcare software and consulting for partners). The company operates a unified digital platform that simplifies access, strengthens engagement, and supports patients throughout their care journeys, and reports serving 22 million patients, delivering 31 million prescriptions, and reaching 90% payer coverage. Fuze Health is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. No public API or developer surface is published at this time.

providers.name: Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals (Shanghai Stock Exchange: 603087) is a Chinese biopharmaceutical company founded in 1998, specializing in the research, development, production, and commercialization of recombinant insulin analogs and injection devices for diabetes care, alongside a growing oncology pipeline and medical devices. Its products, including insulin glargine injections and prefilled pen injectors, are marketed across 23 countries with 19 products launched globally and clinical trials running in 10 countries. Gan & Lee does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: General Medicine
providers.description: General Medicine is a consumer digital-health company building a healthcare storefront for the age of AI, making it delightfully simple to access the best care in the world. Founded by PillPack alumni Elliot Cohen and TJ Parker with CEO Ashwin Muralidharan, the company operates as part telehealth provider, part medical concierge, and part marketplace for browsing and booking medical care, prescriptions, and diagnostic lab testing across more than 35 specialties with board-certified clinicians, transparent pricing, and no waitlists. It is backed by roughly $32M led by Matrix Partners, with BoxGroup, Founder Collective, VXI Capital, and JSL Health Capital participating. General Medicine runs a consumer web storefront (generalmedicine.co) and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: HugeMed
providers.description: HugeMed (Shenzhen HugeMed Medical Technical Development Co., Ltd.) is a high-tech medical-device manufacturer founded in 2014 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, specializing in airway management and endoscopic visualization equipment. Its product portfolio spans video laryngoscopes (blade, flexible, and stylet types for emergency, anesthesia, ICU, and educational use), single-use endoscopes for gynecology, ENT, gastroenterology, pulmonology, and urology, reusable ENT and urology endoscopes, and medical image processors. The company operates production facilities exceeding 60,000 square meters, employs roughly 600 people, and serves more than 10,000 medical institutions across 100+ countries. HugeMed is a hardware-first medical-device maker and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical integration surface; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and enriched with company identity and infrastructure probes.

providers.name: Infervision
providers.description: Infervision is a medical artificial intelligence company that builds AI-powered medical imaging and clinical decision-support software for hospitals and healthcare providers. Its InferRead diagnostic suite assists radiologists with CT and DR reading across lung nodule detection, chest abnormality detection, coronary artery stenosis, stroke and hemorrhage triage, rib fracture identification, and pneumonia triage, while the InferOperate suite provides 3D reconstruction for thoracic, liver, and urological surgical planning. Additional platforms include InferCare for patient management and image follow-up, InferScholar for AI-enabled medical research, and the InferMatrix medical application platform. The company holds FDA 510(k) clearance for InferRead CT Lung, has filed 380+ patents and published 330+ peer-reviewed papers, and operates across 30+ countries. Infervision was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Inofab
providers.description: Inofab Health (a Clario company) is a digital respiratory health company headquartered in Ankara, Turkey, building connected spirometry and inhaler devices with cloud software for the home-based and clinical management of chronic respiratory conditions including asthma, COPD, and cystic fibrosis. Its product line spans the SpiroHome Personal portable ultrasonic spirometer, the SpiroClinic Pro and SpiroClinic Compact clinical-grade spirometers with EHR integration, the SpiroCloud web dashboard that collects and analyzes data from all connected SpiroHome and SpiroClinic devices, and the SpiroHaler smart inhaler attachments for medication adherence. Inofab was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it does not currently publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: KiddoWear
providers.description: KiddoWear (now operating as Kiddo Health) is a pediatric healthcare technology company that offers a connected care platform for capturing and sharing health data for children with physical and behavioral health challenges. The platform combines biometric tracking of 12+ biomarkers (respiration, heart rate, stress scores, and sleep), family journaling of behavior and health status between visits, educational family resources, care navigation that integrates with medical records and clinical workflows, and a provider dashboard that surfaces insights and real-time health trends. Kiddo Health serves behavioral health conditions such as ADHD and autism spectrum disorder and metabolic conditions such as childhood obesity and diabetes, bridging gaps between families, providers, and care teams across health plans, health systems, and employers. A Techstars-backed portfolio company added to the API Evangelist network. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Microhealth
providers.description: Microhealth is a Y Combinator (S15) digital-health company building digital therapeutics and connected patient-provider networks for people living with rare bleeding disorders such as hemophilia and for sickle cell disease. Its products let patients track, manage, and share their treatment journey while giving clinicians real-time monitoring between visits, and it aggregates anonymized real-world evidence for life-science and pharmaceutical research. Products include Microhealth Bleeding Disorders (patient) and Rare Bleeding Disorders HCP (clinician dashboard), Microhealth SCD and SCD HCP for sickle cell disease, and life-science research tooling. The company validates interventions through clinical studies toward regulatory clearance as Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). Its hemophilia network is reported to cover roughly a third of US patients and providers in the specialty, with pharmaceutical clients including Sanofi, Bayer, Novo Nordisk, Biogen, and Roche. Microhealth is a patient- and clinician-facing application platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Nimbus Health
providers.description: Nimbus Health is a technology-enabled network of outpatient pulmonary care clinics treating chronic respiratory disease. Founded in 2022, it acquires and unifies established pulmonary practices onto a shared clinical and operational platform, operating eight clinics across Arizona, Georgia, and South Carolina and serving more than thirty thousand patients with care for COPD, asthma, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary fibrosis, bronchiectasis, sleep apnea, and chronic cough. It is backed by 8VC, 2048 Ventures, and General Catalyst. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Niramai
providers.description: NIRAMAI Health Analytix is a Bangalore, India based deep-tech healthcare company that develops AI-powered, radiation-free breast cancer screening solutions. Its core product, Thermalytix, uses machine learning and deep learning to analyze thermal images of the chest for early-stage tumor detection, complemented by the FDA-cleared SMILE-100 thermal imaging device and the Mythri mobile screening service for primary healthcare settings. The company reports 40+ patents, 55+ clinical publications, and 500,000+ women screened across 22+ countries. Backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass, Niramai publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nonnatech
providers.description: Nonnatech is a New York-based remote patient monitoring (RPM) and virtual health company that provides HIPAA-secured technology and clinical services for healthcare providers. Its platform integrates biometric sensors and passive home devices to deliver real-time analytics, chronic condition management, and population health programs across hospitals, health systems, physician practices, payers, ACOs, home care, long-term care, and senior living communities. Nonnatech offers turnkey device ordering, EHR data integration, and optional clinical monitoring, with no upfront costs to providers and roughly 30-day implementation. Nonnatech is a 500 Global portfolio company. It does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Probably Genetic
providers.description: Probably Genetic is a healthcare company focused on rare disease diagnosis through genetic testing. It offers free targeted genetic testing programs for specific rare conditions (including alpha-mannosidosis, cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis, GRN-FTD, and SYNGAP1-related disorder), insurance-billed testing paired with genetic counselors, at-home saliva/cheek-swab collection kits, and physician-ordered genetic counseling. The platform has served more than 200,000 patients and partners with 50+ patient advocacy groups to advance rare disease research. This is a consumer-facing healthcare provider with no public API or developer program surface.

providers.name: Push Doctor
providers.description: Push Doctor is a UK telehealth company offering video consultations with licensed UK GPs via smartphone, describing itself as the UK's first platform to provide video doctor consultations on mobile. It serves both NHS patients and private paying customers, covering online GP appointments, digital prescriptions, referrals and follow-up care. Headquartered in Manchester and backed by Partech, Push Doctor operates as a consumer-facing telemedicine service; no public developer API, developer portal, or SDK surface was found during enrichment probes.

providers.name: Qvin
providers.description: Qvin is a women's health diagnostics company that develops the Q-Pad, described as the first and only FDA-cleared diagnostic menstrual pad, enabling non-invasive at-home health screening from menstrual blood. The company analyzes collected samples in its CLIA-certified laboratory to test biomarkers for conditions such as diabetes (A1c), and is researching screening for cervical cancer, endometriosis, sexually transmitted infections, and uterine fibroids. Qvin operates as a consumer and clinical diagnostics provider rather than a developer platform, and does not currently publish a public API, SDKs, or developer documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Version One Ventures.

providers.name: Ritual
providers.description: Ritual is a direct-to-consumer health and wellness brand that sells traceable, scientifically-formulated vitamins and nutritional supplements, best known for its Essential for Women multivitamin, prenatal and postnatal formulas, and protein products. The company emphasizes a "clean label" approach with a visible, traceable supply chain and university-backed clinical studies, sold primarily through a subscription model on ritual.com. As of this enrichment pass Ritual operates as a consumer e-commerce business and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: STAND+
providers.description: STAND+ is a Techstars-backed footwear company making biomechanically engineered "energy-recovery" shoes for people who spend long hours standing or walking - healthcare workers, frontline and workforce professionals, athletes, and everyday movers. Its proprietary midsole is designed to dissipate and disperse impact energy outward rather than returning it into the joints, which the company markets for fatigue and pain reduction.
