The product lineup includes the AntiGrav1, AntiGrav2, and AG3 recovery shoes, the Gales Pro and Gales Frontline workforce and healthcare lines, and standalone recovery insoles. STAND+ is APMA (American Podiatric Medical Association) certified and HSA/FSA eligible through a Truemed partnership. This is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand (standshoes.com) with no public developer API, SDK, or integration surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Wellframe
providers.description: Wellframe is a digital health management and member engagement company, now part of HealthEdge, serving health plans and payers. Its platform combines care management, member engagement, and advocacy tooling to help health plans build trusted relationships with members through a mobile app and a clinician-facing dashboard. Wellframe does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; its integrations are delivered as part of enterprise health-plan implementations rather than a self-serve API program.

providers.name: X mart
providers.description: X mart is a 500 Global portfolio company whose website, dentacarts.com, operates DentaCarts, an online dental supplies marketplace positioned as a "Dentist Smart Partner." The storefront sells dental and medical products across categories including restorative materials, endodontics, orthodontics, implants, prosthetics, perio and surgery, instruments, equipment, consumables, dermatology, and dental lab supplies, with support offered over WhatsApp. No public developer API surface has been found.

providers.name: Zwift
providers.description: Zwift is a Long Beach, California online fitness company that operates a multiplayer indoor cycling and running platform combining stationary smart trainers and bikes with a 3D virtual-world game client. Riders and runners use a smart trainer, smart bike (such as the in-house Zwift Ride), treadmill, or pod to drive an avatar through fictional worlds (Watopia, Makuri Islands) and licensed real-world routes, joining structured workouts, group rides, races, training plans, and 24/7 events alongside a global community of more than a million members. The platform pairs with smart trainers and heart-rate monitors over Bluetooth and ANT+, and the Zwift Companion mobile app provides in-game messaging, ride control, and route discovery. Zwift does not operate a general public developer portal, OpenAPI reference, or open-source SDK. Its developer surface is limited to a private, application-only Structured Training API for approved training partners (TrainingPeaks, TrainerRoad, Wahoo SYSTM, JOIN Cycling and similar coaching platforms) that lets external workout builders push custom workouts into a rider's Zwift account, plus one-way activity-export connections to Strava, TrainingPeaks, Garmin Connect, MapMyRide, MapMyRun, Adidas Running, Technogym, Fitbit, Wahoo, Apple Health, and Withings. There is no public REST surface, OAuth client registration, or partner self-service available to general developers — third-party tools (community libraries, ZwiftPower, Sauce for Zwift) interact with Zwift via reverse-engineered private endpoints, not a sanctioned API. Zwift is a paid consumer subscription business; revenue comes from monthly memberships and hardware sales (Zwift Ride, Zwift Cog, Zwift Click, Zwift Play).

providers.name: AppliedVR
providers.description: AppliedVR is a virtual reality therapeutics company that combines immersive technology with proven cognitive behavioral and behavioral-science techniques to treat medical conditions, with a focus on chronic pain. Its lead product, RelieVRx, is the first FDA-authorized prescription VR device for chronic lower back pain, delivering automated, self-administered cognitive behavioral therapy in the patient's home. AppliedVR also offers the SustainVR and ITx immersive therapeutics platform and the AVR Pathway patient-support system, and validates its products through clinical academic research. The company operates as a regulated digital-therapeutics / medical-device business rather than a developer-facing API platform, so it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Atlas5D
providers.description: Atlas5D is a healthcare technology company that develops an Ambient Measurement System (AMS) for assessing health and wellness through motion in any environment. Its passive, privacy-preserving sensor platform recognizes specific individuals, characterizes and quantifies their movement, and interprets daily routines to predict trends and assess risk of adverse events such as falls, without wearables, without transmitting video, and without storing images. Atlas5D serves individuals monitoring aging loved ones, assisted-living and other institutional care settings, and healthcare and clinical-trial teams that need clinical-grade, real-world evidence of patient movement wherever people live. Backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Cera
providers.description: Cera is a United Kingdom-based digital-first home healthcare company, founded in 2016 and headquartered in London, that describes itself as Europe's largest provider of in-home care. Cera delivers home care, live-in care, nurse-led and complex care, extra-care housing, supported living, and specialist learning-disability and autism support, all wrapped around a proprietary digital platform that uses data analytics and machine learning so its network of carers can collect, monitor, and react to vital-sign and health-condition changes in real time. Cera positions this technology as a remote-monitoring and predictive layer that surfaces deterioration in health earlier and reduces hospitalisations across its United Kingdom home-care operations. As of this review Cera exposes no public developer portal, no self-serve REST API, and no HL7 FHIR endpoint or CapabilityStatement; its platform is an internal, operator-facing product delivered through consumer and carer mobile apps rather than a documented partner API. This profile is an honest identity-only stub recording the absence of a public API surface for a United Kingdom telehealth-adjacent home-care provider.

providers.name: Denta
providers.description: Denta is a San Francisco-based dental practice management and automation platform, founded by Jack Beecher (Jack Beecher LLC, dba Denta) and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026 batch). Positioned as "the dental practice that runs itself," Denta embeds AI into dental organizations to automate back-office operations: it ingests fragmented data from a practice's existing software, provides analytics so dentists can understand their business, and runs in the background to handle administrative work such as insurance payment posting. Its roadmap includes all-in-one native practice management software and an "autonomous dental practice." As of this profile Denta publishes a marketing site, a blog, and login and legal pages, but no public developer portal, API, or OpenAPI surface has been located.

providers.name: EyeLights
providers.description: EyeLights is a French deep-tech company building augmented reality head-up display (HUD) technology for riders and pilots. Its products project GPS navigation, speed, intercom, radar and call information into the rider's line of sight: EyeRide, a universal HUD accessory compatible with any motorcycle helmet; the GT-AIR 3 Smart, an integrated head-up display visor built into a SHOEI helmet; the APEX HUD glasses for general aviation; and Pulse Ultra, a universal Bluetooth intercom. The company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at eye-lights.com and runs customer support on Odoo. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead; EyeLights publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time, so this record captures its consumer web, identity, and security posture rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Grouper
providers.description: Grouper, operated by Element3 Health, Inc. (d/b/a Grouper) and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, is a healthy-aging benefit company that connects older adults to social clubs, group activities, and virtual community programming through health plans. Its consumer product, "Hello by Grouper," is a membership platform offering live and on-demand instructor-led virtual classes, research-based monthly brain-health challenges, and members-only online events, with the goal of keeping members active, socially connected, and healthier as they age. Grouper distributes primarily through Medicare Advantage and other health-plan partners rather than a direct developer channel; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface as of this profile, which was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture (a16z-associated) portfolio lead.

providers.name: Happytal
providers.description: Happytal is a French healthtech and services company founded in 2013 and acquired by La Poste Group's health division (La Poste Santé) in 2022. It operates a hospital concierge service (conciergerie hospitalière) that combines a digital platform with on-site human concierges to simplify the administrative, medical and hotel journey of each patient. Services include in-room delivery, a comfort-products marketplace, private-room and admission paperwork assistance, and support for patients, their families and hospital staff across French healthcare establishments, alongside elder-care/EHPAD offerings and the careside.care business-to-business product for care facilities. Happytal exposes no public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Slingshot AI
providers.description: Slingshot AI is a mental-health AI research lab building a foundation model for psychology. Its consumer product, Ash, is a voice- and text-based AI companion for mental health support, trained on behavioral-health approaches including CBT, DBT, ACT, psychodynamic therapy, and motivational interviewing, and shipped as a free iOS and Android app. Founded by Neil Parikh (co-founder of Casper) and Daniel Reid Cahn, the company has raised roughly $93M from investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Forerunner Ventures, Menlo Ventures, and Radical Ventures. As of this pass Slingshot AI publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; Ash is a consumer-facing application at talktoash.com.

providers.name: West Technology Group
providers.description: West Technology Group is a cloud-based global technology company providing customer experience and communications solutions through its WestCX platform. The company operates through two main brands: Mosaicx, which delivers AI-native conversational automation for enterprise customer engagement, and TeleVox, which provides digital patient engagement solutions for healthcare organizations including providers, payers, and life sciences companies.

providers.name: Citruslabs
providers.description: Citruslabs is a clinical research organization (CRO) that designs and runs clinical trials, consumer perception studies, and randomized controlled trials for consumer health brands across supplements, skincare, pet health, food and beverage, longevity, and women's health. It handles IRB approval, protocol design, participant recruitment, decentralized data collection, and statistical analysis, then turns results into regulator-reviewed, marketing-ready product claims for retailers, advertising, and packaging. Studies range from DIY consumer perception studies to full randomized controlled trials, typically completing in four to sixteen weeks.

providers.name: Embark
providers.description: Embark Veterinary is a dog genetics company that sells at-home canine DNA testing kits for breed identification, health condition and genetic-risk screening, trait analysis, and relative matching, alongside supplements and breeder/veterinary testing programs. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, the company operates a direct-to-consumer storefront, a help center, and a resources/blog library, but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced from VC-portfolio data; no machine-readable API surface (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, MCP) was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Sol
providers.description: Sol Reader is a wearable e-reader — marketed as the world's first wearable e-reader — built by Sol and backed by Initialized Capital. The device is a lightweight (104g) headset with dual 1.3" 271ppi side-lit E Ink displays, adjustable diopter optics and IPD, a handheld remote, and 25+ hours of battery for a distraction-free reading experience. It reads a connected Kindle library and DRM-free EPUB uploads, offers the Sol Store with over one million titles, plus AI question-answering and an AutoPilot speed-reading mode. Sol is a consumer hardware company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Somnee
providers.description: Somnee is a consumer sleep-technology company behind a smart sleep headband that uses personalized neurostimulation to improve sleep. Developed over roughly eight years by a team of UC Berkeley neuroscientists (co-founders include sleep scientist Dr. Matthew Walker, Dr. Robert T. Knight, Dr. Rich Ivry, and CSTO Dr. Ram Gurumoorthy, with CEO Tim Rosa, former Fitbit CMO), the wearable pairs clinical-grade EEG+ sensors with a companion app and proprietary AI to deliver a 15-minute pre-bedtime session that the company says helps users fall asleep about 50% faster and cut nighttime wake-ups by roughly a third, without medication. Somnee sells the headband, accessories, and a sleep-service membership direct to consumers, and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Somnee publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: AgadoLive
providers.description: Agado Live is an AI-powered telerehabilitation platform built for physical therapy clinics, letting one therapist supervise many patients at once while capturing measurable outcomes. Its computer-vision engine extracts joint kinematics in real time from a single smartphone or webcam, with no wearables, markers, or proprietary hardware, then flags form issues live and directs the therapist's attention where it is needed most. The platform delivers Live Group Care, AI movement assessment, auto-generated SOAP notes, and specialized orthopedic, neurological, and geriatric protocols. Founded by Tzach Goren, Gili Yaron, Gil Shamai, and Vittaly Tavor, Agado Live operates from Tel Aviv and Boston and is backed by Techstars. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; the company publishes a marketing and clinical site but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Arctic Health
providers.description: Arctic Health provides AI-native provider credentialing and payer enrollment for healthcare organizations, handling the workflow end to end — from CAQH management and primary source verification to payer applications, contracting, and ongoing follow-up. The company collects and validates organization and provider data to each state and payer's requirements, submits on the organization's behalf across hundreds of payer portals, and monitors status and compliance on an ongoing basis. It serves medical practices, telehealth groups, RCM companies, and CVOs across all 50 states plus DC, offering both standard and white-label ("For Scale") solutions with AI-powered document extraction and error detection. Arctic Health is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company based in New York City, also backed by Menlo Ventures and Fortitude Ventures.

providers.name: Assort Health
providers.description: Assort Health builds agentic AI voice agents purpose-built for healthcare organizations, automating the full patient journey through natural voice interactions. The platform handles 24/7 appointment scheduling and management, intelligent patient triage and routing, patient intake, insurance eligibility verification, referral and fax automation, proactive outbound outreach, medication refill management, and payment resolution. It integrates with EHR and practice-management systems and is trained on more than 150M patient interactions across 5,000+ providers and 23+ medical specialties. Founded in 2023 by Jeff Liu and Jon Wang, the company is backed by Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, First Round Capital, Felicis, Chemistry, and others. This profile is maintained as part of the API Evangelist network; Assort Health does not currently publish a public developer program, API reference, or OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: Careforce
providers.description: Careforce (Helpcare AI, Inc., d/b/a Careforce) provides an autonomous AI workforce platform for healthcare operations. Its AI agents — Angelica, a care coordinator handling preventive-care outreach, appointment scheduling, reminders, and referral management, and David, a data analyst that pulls and analyzes patient data across EHR and portal systems — integrate with 30+ healthcare platforms including Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth, and NextGen to close care gaps and reduce staff workload. Backed by CRV. Careforce consumes third-party healthcare APIs rather than publishing a public developer API; no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs were found.

providers.name: Chapter
providers.description: Chapter is a technology-driven Medicare advisory service (parent company Memoir, Inc.; insurance services via Chapter Advisory, LLC) that helps older Americans navigate retirement healthcare. Licensed advisors and self-service tools compare and enroll consumers across all major Medicare carriers nationwide, representing 50 organizations offering more than 15,000 products, and serving 500,000+ enrollees with a 4.9/5 rating across 6,700+ reviews. Chapter is HIPAA compliant, BBB accredited, and also ships a consumer OTC benefits app. Founded 2020 in New York City; backed by Addition. This is a consumer healthtech company with no public developer/API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Cityblock Health
providers.description: Cityblock Health is a value-based healthcare provider delivering relationship-based primary care, behavioral and mental health support, social care services, urgent care, and hospital-to-home transitions to underserved and Medicaid-eligible communities. Care is coordinated by Community Health Partners who connect members with medical providers, therapists, clinical pharmacists, and social resources. Cityblock operates clinics across nine states plus Washington, D.C., working in partnership with health insurance plans. Backed by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Clinikk
providers.description: Clinikk (Clinikk Health Hub) is a Bangalore, India-based primary healthcare provider offering membership-based access to unlimited doctor consultations, free prescribed medicines and lab tests, 24/7 teleconsultation, and optional group health insurance in partnership with IndusInd General Insurance. Clinikk operates in-person Health Hubs across Bangalore alongside a consumer mobile app, and was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Consure Medical
providers.description: Consure Medical is a nurse-centric medical device company with Silicon Valley roots that develops incontinence and critical-care management solutions for hospitals. Its product line includes the QiVi family of truly external male and female urine management catheters, the Qora SMK manual stool management kit, and the Qoramatic automated stool management system, all designed to reduce catheter-associated urinary tract infections (CAUTI), incontinence-associated dermatitis (IAD), and hospital-acquired conditions while improving patient dignity. The company operates from San Diego, California and New Delhi, India, and markets its devices through partners such as Medline. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Consure Medical publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Covera Health
providers.description: Covera Health is a clinical intelligence company that delivers AI-powered quality insights across the healthcare ecosystem, beginning with diagnostic radiology. Its Connected Platform helps providers, health plans, and employers improve diagnostic accuracy and care coordination across high-cost conditions including musculoskeletal disorders, cancer, neurological disease, heart disease, chronic pain, and metabolic disease. Certified as a Patient Safety Organization by AHRQ, Covera focuses on reducing misdiagnosis, unnecessary cost, and patient harm from the point of diagnosis through care delivery, prior authorization, and claims administration. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Gatherhealth
providers.description: Gather Health is a Boston-area primary care organization delivering team-based, community-centered medical care for seniors aged 65+ on Medicare. Operating neighborhood locations across Quincy, Lynn, Dorchester, and Brockton, each patient is supported by a care team of a primary care provider, a "Gather Guide," and a medical technician, with both in-office and home-based visits, care coordination with specialists and hospitals, and 24/7 urgent care support. Gather Health is a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures. As a care-delivery organization it does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; it uses athenahealth for its patient portal. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity record.

providers.name: Groups
providers.description: Groups (Groups Recover Together, joingroups.com) is a healthcare provider delivering outpatient opioid use disorder treatment that combines Suboxone (buprenorphine) medication-assisted treatment with weekly group therapy and individual care coordination. Founded in 2014 and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Groups operates in-person locations nationwide alongside a virtual/telehealth care option and a member mobile app, accepting most commercial insurance and Medicaid. It is CARF-accredited and focuses on accessible, non-judgmental, long-term recovery. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Groups is a direct-to-consumer clinical service and publishes no public developer API surface at the time of profiling.

providers.name: GymNadz
providers.description: GymNadz is a women-focused fitness application offering personalized workout programs, nutrition and meal plans, and community features. The platform provides a library of 300+ exercises with customizable workout and meal plans tailored to individual fitness goals, plus progress tracking and coach interaction. It is delivered as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps rather than as a developer platform. GymNadz is a portfolio company of 500 Global, tracked in the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Included Health
providers.description: Included Health is a healthcare company that delivers personalized virtual care and healthcare navigation to members through their employers and health plans. The platform combines virtual primary, urgent, behavioral, and specialty care with a 24/7 Care Team that handles benefits navigation, provider matching, billing and claims advocacy, and expert medical opinions. Sold B2B to employers, health plans, labor and trust organizations, and the public sector, Included Health surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Greylock portfolio company; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or well-known discovery surface, so this profile captures company identity and live domain-security posture rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Karius
providers.description: Karius is an infectious disease diagnostics company that applies clinical metagenomics and machine learning to microbial cell-free DNA (mcfDNA) circulating in the bloodstream, detecting pathogens that conventional culture-based testing misses. Its CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited laboratory runs the Karius Spectrum blood test, which screens a single blood draw for more than 1,000 bacteria, fungi, DNA viruses, and parasites, and the Karius Focus BAL test, which detects more than 500 pathogens in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid for lung infections. Results are returned to clinicians managing complex, immunocompromised, and difficult-to-diagnose patients.

providers.name: Loop Health
providers.description: Loop Health is an India-based health assurance and group insurance company, founded in 2018 by Mayank Kale and Amrit Singh and headquartered in Pune. It combines traditional group hospitalization insurance with unlimited primary care, telemedicine, wellness programs, mental-health counseling, and an Employee Assistance Program, delivered to employers and their teams through asset-light clinics and a member app. Backed by General Catalyst, Elevation Capital and Y Combinator, Loop serves 1,250+ companies and 950,000+ members across India. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass Loop Health publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Mahmee
providers.description: Mahmee is a wraparound maternal and infant healthcare platform that connects expectant and new parents with integrated, coordinated teams of nurses, doulas, lactation consultants (IBCLCs), mental health coaches, and nutritionists through virtual and in-person appointments. Founded by Melissa Hanna (CEO) and Linda Hanna (Director of Care), the platform delivers evidence-based pregnancy and postpartum care — including remote blood pressure monitoring, in-home newborn jaundice phototherapy, and lactation support — across all 50 U.S. states, with in-person clinics in California. Mahmee works with major insurers such as Aetna, Cigna, Kaiser Permanente, and United Healthcare, and focuses on reducing maternal health disparities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Memora Health
providers.description: Memora Health is a healthcare technology company (now part of Commure) that provides an AI-powered platform for digitizing and automating complex care programs. Its intelligent care enablement platform combines clinical workflow automation, remote patient monitoring, symptom management, medication adherence, and patient education to reduce clinician inbox burden and keep enrolled patients engaged between visits. Memora serves health systems and provider organizations across maternal care, surgical care, gastrointestinal care, oncology, chronic care management, population health, and transitions of care. The company operates as an enterprise B2B solution and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; integrations are delivered through direct enterprise engagements. Backed by General Catalyst, Memora is migrating onto the Commure platform at commure.com/engage.

providers.name: Mendaera
providers.description: Mendaera is a healthcare robotics company building the Focalist handheld robotic system, which combines robotics, real-time ultrasound imaging, and software to guide needle-based medical procedures with greater precision and consistency. The FDA-cleared platform is preparing for broad commercial launch in 2026. Mendaera is backed by Lux Capital, Threshold Ventures, Founders Fund, PFM Health Sciences, and Puma Venture Capital. The company is focused on medical devices rather than a developer-facing platform; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Midi Health
providers.description: Midi Health is a virtual care platform for women in midlife, delivering insurance-covered telemedicine from clinicians who specialize in perimenopause, menopause, and related midlife health. Patients get personalized care plans spanning hormone therapy (HRT), GLP-1 and weight management, sexual wellness, mood, sleep, hair and skin, and cancer-survivorship care, plus prescriptions, compounded medications, and supplements, with coverage available across all 50 states. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), Midi operates as a direct-to-consumer and employer/health-plan telehealth service. No public API, developer portal, or technical developer surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Nourish
providers.description: Nourish is a virtual nutrition-counseling telehealth platform that connects patients with Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs) through insurance-covered video appointments in all 50 states. Its network of more than 10,000 dietitians supports conditions including diabetes, eating disorders, heart health, and gut health, and a companion mobile app handles meal and goal tracking, secure messaging, lab-work review, and between-session support. Nourish verifies insurance and submits claims on the patient's behalf, with the company reporting that 94% of patients pay $0 out of pocket. Backed by Index Ventures, Menlo Ventures, and Susa Ventures, the company raised a $100M Series C. Nourish exposes a consumer marketing and patient-app surface only; no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: Oceans
providers.description: Oceans Healthcare is a behavioral health system operating a network of psychiatric hospitals and outpatient programs across the southern United States. Founded in 2010 and backed by General Catalyst, the company delivers inpatient and outpatient mental health treatment for adolescents, adults, older adults, and veterans and first responders, spanning acute inpatient psychiatry, partial hospitalization, intensive outpatient, and virtual telehealth care. Oceans Healthcare is a care-delivery operator focused on safety, stability, and lasting healing; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition at this time.

providers.name: Osmind
providers.description: Osmind is an interventional psychiatry platform that powers what it describes as the largest network of interventional psychiatry practices in the United States. The company provides a purpose-built electronic health record (EHR), billing and revenue-cycle management (RCM), measurement-based care and outcomes tracking, and a patient mobile app for practices delivering treatments such as ketamine, Spravato (esketamine), TMS, and other novel and interventional mental-health therapies. Osmind reports serving 1,000+ practices and supporting more than one million treatments delivered. It is a private B2B healthcare SaaS company backed by General Catalyst and other investors. As of this profile, Osmind publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or webhook surface on its public site.

providers.name: Pearl Health
providers.description: Pearl Health is a healthcare technology company that provides value-based care intelligence for physicians, primary care practices, physician networks, and health systems. Its platform acts as an operating system for value-based care, ingesting Medicare claims data, ADT feeds, and EHR information to identify high-risk patients, prioritize care activities with actionable next steps and automated administrative workflows, and optimize financial performance under Traditional Medicare and Medicare Advantage risk arrangements. Pearl reports serving 5,000+ providers across 40+ states, managing roughly 250,000 beneficiaries. The company connects to existing EHR systems but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as an a16z and SV Angel portfolio company and enriched from the provider's public web surface.
